Strategic Program Manager
jobs.description:
Calix delivers a broadband platform and managed services that enable our customers and partners to improve life one community at a time. We’re at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the industry and Calix is making strategic investments to establish MDU as a major growth engine and future billion\-dollar business. To achieve this, Calix is forming a dedicated, cross\-functional managed business team responsible for defining not only the market strategy, but the complete customer and operational models required to scale profitably. Join us as we innovate, help our customers/partners reach their potential, and connect with unrivaled digital experiences.
It’s an exciting time to join Calix as we build the Industry Solutions Group, a new business unit focused on managed business. The **Strategic** **Program Manager** will play a critical role in executing cross\-functional initiatives that support the build and scale of the managed business growth engine. This role is responsible for translating defined priorities into structured execution plans and driving delivery across multiple workstreams.


In this role, you will be expected to flex your strategic skills and operate as a strategic partner to the managed business leadership team — helping shape priorities, pressure\-test plans, surface tradeoffs, challenge assumptions, and drive the conversations required to build a new market category for Calix. This will include traditional program management competencies as well such as leading program planning, coordinating cross\-functional execution, tracking progress against milestones, and ensuring accountability across teams.


The ideal candidate is a strategic operator — someone who combines strong program discipline with business curiosity, sound judgment, and the confidence to ask hard questions, enjoys building scalable processes, and pushes cross\-functional teams toward clarity, commitment, and measurable outcomes.

**Responsibilities and Duties****:**

* Contribute to the PMO discipline across managed business workstreams,focused on productivity and effectiveness, ensuring priorities, milestones, owners, dependencies, blockers, and decisions are clearly documented and actively managed across functions.
* Ensure consistency in program management practices across initiatives, applying standard frameworks, tools, and methodologies.
* Lead execution of cross\-functional programs from planning through delivery, ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, deliverables, and success metrics.
* Coordinate across functional teams to ensure workstreams are progressing according to plan and interdependencies are actively managed.
* Pressure\-test plans, assumptions, dependencies, and tradeoffs across workstreams to ensure the business is building toward the right outcomes — not just completing tasks.
* Smoothly navigate ambiguity creating clarity across complex, unknown, and evolving business\-model decisions.
* Proactively surface misalignment, risks, and unresolved decisions, then drive the right conversations to create clarity and forward momentum.
* Facilitate the formal and informal communication and conversations required to move work forward, including executive readouts, working sessions, offline follow\-ups, sidebar conversations, and escalation paths.
* Support prioritization and sequencing of work based on timelines, resource availability, and business impact.
* Influence without authority across senior stakeholders, using judgment, credibility, and relationship\-building to hold teams accountable to commitments and outcomes.
* Model a drive towards measurable outcomes with a bias towards action.
* Support continuous improvement of program management processes, tools, and team effectiveness.
**Qualifications****:**

* 8\-10\+ years of experience in Program Management, Project Management or cross\-functional program leadership roles.
* Experience and knowledge of multi\-family, MDU, and/or wi\-fi infrastructure a bonus.
* Experience with launching new business units, startup companies and/or Merge \& Acquisition (M\&A) project a bonus.
* Proven ability to manage complex, cross\-functional programs with multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously and prioritize effectively.
* Experience developing and maintaining program plans, tracking tools, and status reporting artifacts.
* Demonstrated ability to proactively identify risks and drive resolution in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly convey updates, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, while managing ambiguity.
* Ability to work effectively across functions and build strong working relationships without direct authority.
* Detail\-oriented with a focus on execution quality, timelines, and accountability.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience preferred; PMP or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Expected Travel: \~5%

**Location:**

* This is a remote\-based position that can be located anywhere in the United States or Canada.

**Red Nucleus is hiring a Business Analyst, Operations to join our global team. This role will be remote.**

  

Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 800 full\-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on\-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.  



  

At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a “Great Place to Work".

The Business Analyst, Operation is responsible for executing, maintaining, and continuously improving the enterprise delivery operating model, governance processes, resource management practices, and operational reporting capabilities. This position partners closely with Operations Leads, Project Management, Resource Managers, Finance, Sales Operations, and Business Systems teams to ensure enterprise standards are consistently executed and operational insights are translated into actionable improvements.

jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager / Operations Lead
jobs.description:
### **At Team Carney, we believe that true performance acceleration happens at the intersection of innovative learning and deep strategic expertise. Since 1994, our mission has been to provide top\-tier training, learning, and human capital solutions that empower Federal Government agencies to meet their critical mandates. We are seeking a results\-oriented Deputy Program Manager / Operations Lead to oversee daily operational execution across enterprise learning programs supporting the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).**


This position is contingent upon award.

### **Work Schedule and Location**

* This position is remote with periodic on\-site presence in Silver Spring, MD
* Clearance Requirement: Current or ability to obtain Public Trust clearance required.

### **Who You Are \& What You’ll Do**


As the Deputy Program Manager / Operations Lead, you will partner directly with the Program Manager to ensure seamless day\-to\-day coordination, task area execution, resource allocation, and deliverable quality. You will maintain operational oversight over training intake tracking, LMS scheduling, staffing rosters, and cross\-functional team workflows. You will serve as the secondary point of contact for government stakeholders and step into full leadership authority in the Program Manager's absence, preserving continuity of operations across all contractual task areas.

### **What You Bring to the Table \- Requirements**

* Experience: **At least seven (7\) years of experience** in federal program or operations management, with demonstrated success managing multi\-functional service delivery environments in learning, human capital, or technical fields.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, education, public administration, or a related field.
* Operational Expertise: Strong expertise in workflow coordination, schedule monitoring, risk tracking, subcontractor oversight, and quality assurance processes.
* Stakeholder Management: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to interface effectively with federal government representatives and cross\-functional project teams.
* Process Controls: Experience implementing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), tracking training intake metrics, and supporting monthly status reporting.

### **Why Join Team Carney?**


When you join Team Carney, you join a legacy of excellence. We focus on our people because when we make a positive impact on the lives of our employees, they are able to make a positive impact on our clients. We offer a full suite of competitive benefits, including:

* Health \& Wellness: Multiple medical, dental, and vision insurance options (BCBS CareFirst), health spending accounts (HSA), and flexible spending accounts (FSA).
* Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plus Carney\-paid life and disability insurance.
* Work\-Life Harmony: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 paid holidays, and 6 weeks of paid parental leave.
* Professional \& Personal Growth: Annual tuition assistance (up to $5,000\) and student loan repayment.
* Get Out and Learn: Up to $200 annually to learn almost anything (from pottery to coding!).
* Get Out and Run: Up to $200 annually to participate in fitness and active lifestyle events.
* Continuous Development: Ad hoc training and ongoing professional development access.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Turing is looking for candidates with strong experience in project planning, execution, and stakeholder coordination, particularly at the level expected for professional project managers leading cross\-functional teams and complex technical or scientific initiatives. **Role overview:*** In this role, you will contribute to projects that help evaluate and enhance AI systems using your project management and organizational expertise.
* No prior AI experience is required.
* These projects will help you explore how AI can improve workflow planning, communication, and process automation across professional and technical environments.

 **What does day\-to\-day look like:*** Design and solve real\-world project management and coordination scenarios to test AI reasoning.
* Write clear, structured explanations covering project scheduling, risk assessment, resource allocation, and performance tracking.
* Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, clarity, and alignment with industry project management frameworks.
* Collaborate with researchers to refine AI understanding of PMI’s PMBOK, Agile, and Scrum methodologies.

 **Requirements:*** 4\+ years of experience as a Project Manager, Program Coordinator, or Project Management Specialist.
* Background in Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, MS Project) and frameworks (Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall).
* Excellent English communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain structured processes clearly.

 **Perks of freelancing with Turing:*** Strong compensation (exact amount varies by project).
* Fully remote work environment.
* Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer, potentially full\-time.
* Duration of projects: approximately 1 month, with the possibility for extension.

 **What Turing is NOT seeking from your expertise:*** Confidential or proprietary information from any employer, university, etc.
* Trade secrets or internal company or university data.
* Specific client information or case details.
* Any information that would violate NDAs, employment agreements or other confidentiality obligations.

 **About Turing:**
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high\-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P\&L.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Power Conversion and Storage
jobs.description:
Are you a driven project leader with a passion for clean energy? GE Vernova's Power Conversion and Storage business is looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to own the full lifecycle of high\-impact, large\-scale renewable energy projects across the Americas.
  

  

You'll be the critical link between our customers and our internal teams — steering complex, multi\-million\-dollar solar and BESS projects from contract award to successful closeout while delivering on safety, quality, schedule, and financial performance.
  

  

This is a high\-visibility role reporting directly to the Americas Region Projects \& Services Leader, offering significant career growth potential within one of the world's leading energy technology companies.
**Job Description**
===================


**What You'll Do**


* Lead major energy projects valued between \\$10M and \\$200M, spanning utility\-scale solar and battery energy storage systems
* Be the customer champion — building trust through clear communication, proactive issue resolution, and consistent delivery against expectations
* Own the full contract lifecycle — from finalization through closeout, including reporting, receivables management, change order and claim negotiations
* Drive business performance across safety, quality, schedule, cost, margin, cash flow, and risk management
* Connect the dots internally — aligning cross\-functional GE Vernova teams and business units to ensure seamless product delivery and commissioning
* Communicate with impact — keeping internal and external stakeholders informed on project goals, risks, opportunities, and strategies
* Champion a culture of excellence — fostering an inclusive, engaged team environment that consistently achieves project management best\-in\-class results
* Protect and strengthen GE Vernova's reputation in the marketplace through professional, ethical project execution

**What We're Looking For**


**Required qualifications:**


* Bachelors degree (Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or a related field)
* Minimum 5 years of project management, customer management experience or related professional experience (GE or energy industry experience a plus)
* Fluent English communication skills — written and verbal, technical and commercial
* Demonstrated success leading and motivating multi\-cultural, cross\-functional teams
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at all levels of an organization
* Ability to travel up to 20%

**Preferred qualifications:**


* Experience in solar and/or BESS power plant design, procurement, or construction
* Prior experience with GE Vernova Power Conversion and Storage products and processes
* Background in Lean / continuous improvement methodologies

**Position Title:** Program Manager – National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA)

**Location:** Hybrid – remote collaboration with on\-site support at designated U.S. Government facilities as required by the Government

**Work Type:** Full\-time

**Position Overview**

The National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) is an agency within the U.S. Department of Commerce responsible for advising the President on telecommunications and information policy matters, including expanding broadband access and adoption, managing Federal spectrum use, advancing telecommunications innovation, supporting public safety communications, and promoting policies that support the growth of the digital economy.

This position supports NTIA's Office of Policy Coordination and Management (OPCM), which provides enterprise mission enablement support services across NTIA, including financial management, budget execution, strategic planning, human resources coordination, information technology operational coordination, acquisitions support, administrative operations, facilities and property management, reporting support, process improvement initiatives, workforce support, and enterprise operational coordination. OPCM operates in a dynamic environment that requires agile operational support capable of adapting to changing mission priorities, executive direction, emerging issues, workload fluctuations, and evolving organizational requirements.

The Program Manager is designated as Key Personnel and serves as the primary point of contact between the contractor and the Government. The Program Manager is responsible for overall contract management, operational coordination, staffing oversight, workload prioritization, reporting oversight, quality management, and mission support coordination in support of NTIA's agile, cross\-functional operational support services. The position requires demonstrated experience supporting operational support activities, agile operational environments, executive coordination activities, and Government mission support operations.

This program places significant emphasis on key personnel. In the event the Program Manager is unable to perform, the contractor must submit detailed written explanations of the circumstances, complete resumes for the proposed substitute, and any other information the Government deems pertinent, and no substitution may be made without the prior written approval of the Contracting Officer or Contracting Officer's Representative.

* Serve as the primary point of contact between the contractor team and NTIA representatives, facilitating effective communication and timely resolution of issues.
* Provide comprehensive project oversight, including planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and implementation, ensuring alignment with NTIA's objectives and compliance with all contractual requirements.
* Monitor project progress against goals and benchmarks, making adjustments as necessary to maintain project trajectory and meet deliverables.
* Lead and motivate the project team, fostering a collaborative environment and ensuring adherence to quality standards and ethical practices.
* Prepare and present regular project reports and updates to NTIA and other stakeholders, highlighting progress, challenges, and strategies for mitigation.
* Coordinate with various NTIA offices and external entities as required, ensuring smooth project integration and alignment with broader organizational goals.
* Implement risk management practices, identifying potential project risks and developing contingency plans.

* Provide program management office (PMO) support, executive tasker coordination, operational planning support, and risk and issue tracking across functional task areas.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Givenly**

Givenly is an AI\-first platform for corporate gifting, employee recognition, branded merchandise, company stores, and custom kitting. We help organizations consolidate several disconnected vendors and programs into one system with centralized controls, reporting, and fulfillment.

We are a small, established company with enterprise clients, proprietary technology, a broad vendor network, and a highly collaborative remote team. Our work combines software, e\-commerce, physical products, vendor management, fulfillment, and client service.

**The Role**

Givenly is seeking a hands\-on Operations Manager to lead day\-to\-day execution across order management, custom projects, vendor fulfillment, client onboarding, product data, billing coordination, and operational improvement.

This is not a passive oversight role. You will manage a small operations team, establish clear priorities, remove blockers, enforce deadlines, and ensure work reaches accurate and complete resolution. You must be comfortable moving between leadership and direct execution when circumstances require it.

The right person quickly turns ambiguity into a practical plan. You identify the desired outcome, separate essential facts from distractions, assign ownership, make sound decisions, and drive work to completion. You use technology and AI to accelerate work while applying independent judgment and verifying results.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership and Accountability**

* Lead, coach, and hold accountable a small remote operations team.
* Translate company priorities into clear assignments, owners, deadlines, and measurable deliverables.
* Maintain command of all active operational initiatives, aging work, risks, and dependencies.
* Detect stalled work early and intervene before deadlines or client commitments are missed.
* Establish a consistent operating rhythm for weekly priorities, status reporting, escalation, and completion.
* Provide the CEO with concise, decision\-ready updates rather than activity summaries.

**Order, Project, and Client Operations**

* Oversee branded merchandise orders, custom kits, company\-store projects, redemptions, and client onboarding.
* Ensure quotes, proofs, purchase orders, production schedules, shipping details, tracking, and final delivery are managed accurately.
* Coordinate complex projects across clients, salespeople, vendors, fulfillment partners, and internal team members.
* Resolve operational issues quickly and communicate clearly with clients and stakeholders.
* Ensure client commitments, event dates, and holiday deadlines are protected.

**Vendor and Fulfillment Management**

* Manage relationships and performance across suppliers, decorators, fulfillment houses, and logistics partners.
* Hold vendors accountable for quality, pricing, documentation, lead times, and service levels.
* Escalate production, quality, shipping, and billing issues before they affect clients.
* Support vendor sourcing, onboarding, integrations, and performance reviews.
* Maintain contingency options for critical products, services, and fulfillment capacity.

**Process Control and Quality Assurance**

* Ensure established processes are followed accurately, completely, and consistently.
* Improve processes when evidence supports a change, without adding unnecessary complexity.
* Build practical controls that prevent errors while preserving speed and ownership.
* Oversee quality assurance for product data, catalogs, pricing, images, imports, orders, proofs, and client\-facing experiences.
* Preserve clean source data, documentation, and audit trails.
* Ensure recurring work is documented and can be performed without dependence on one employee's institutional knowledge.

**Systems, Data, and AI**

* Use AI, automation, spreadsheets, and Givenly's proprietary platform to increase operational speed and accuracy.
* Apply sound judgment when using AI and independently verify important outputs.
* Manage structured data across vendors, product catalogs, client stores, internal systems, and reporting tools.
* Work comfortably with spreadsheets, formulas, imports, exports, reconciliations, and large datasets.
* Partner with the CEO and technology team to identify high\-value automation and platform improvements.

**Financial and Administrative Coordination**

* Support invoice review, vendor billing, commissions, inventory reconciliation, and client billing accuracy.
* Identify margin leakage, incorrect charges, duplicate expenses, and reconciliation issues.
* Maintain complete operational documentation for financial review and decision\-making.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 90 days, the Operations Manager will:

* Establish clear visibility into every active operational initiative.
* Reduce aging and overdue work while preventing new backlog accumulation.
* Create reliable ownership, deadline, and escalation discipline across the team.
* Improve the speed and completeness of order and project execution.
* Reduce CEO involvement in routine operational problem\-solving.
* Document critical workflows and eliminate key\-person dependencies.
* Improve vendor accountability, data accuracy, and quality control.
* Develop a practical operating plan for peak and holiday volume.

**Required Qualifications**

* Five or more years of operations, project management, fulfillment, e\-commerce, logistics, supply chain, or related experience.
* Two or more years managing and holding accountable a small team.
* Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose problems and drive them through resolution.
* Strong prioritization, critical\-thinking, and decision\-making skills.
* Proven success managing multiple concurrent projects, deadlines, and external partners.
* Advanced spreadsheet skills and comfort working with structured operational data.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Experience operating effectively in a small company, startup, or high\-accountability envir

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager IV - Internal Only
jobs.description:
Our Mission  


As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and accessible workplace where all people feel comfortable being themselves. We're looking to grow our teams with more people who share our enthusiasm for innovation and creating the best experience for job seekers.  


(\*Comscore, Total Visits, March 2026\)  


Day to Day  


As a Senior Technology Risk Program Manager, you will own programs designed to identify, assess, and reduce security risk across Indeed. You will partner closely with Security, Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and leadership teams to drive risk treatment and inform decisions about security risk, business priorities, and investment. In this role, you will operationalize security risk management at scale through an integrated approach spanning strategic, operational, and tactical risk, as well as security exceptions, helping teams make informed, timely decisions and manage risk consistently across the organization.  


You will apply deep security, risk, and compliance expertise to assess complex issues, identify systemic patterns, and develop informed recommendations that translate into scalable solutions, proportionate controls, and risk\-informed standards. You will provide leadership with actionable visibility into material and emerging risks, treatment progress, trends, and decisions requiring attention, while using data, metrics, automation, artificial intelligence, and technology to improve risk visibility, operational efficiency, and proactive risk management at scale. You will also help foster cross\-functional collaboration and strengthen risk management practices by mentoring partners and team members on risk judgment, security and compliance concepts, and effective program execution.

jobs.description:
Overview:
**TISTA Science and Technology Corporation** is seeking to hire a **Technical** **Project Manager** to join our team!  

  

TISTA is seeking a Project Manager to provide management, direction, administration, quality assurance, and leadership of project staff execution for each of the assigned Service Programs. This person will provide day\-to\-day support of financial services programs and projects including quality monitoring and SME\-level inputs to improve the overall performance of the assigned programs/projects. Responsibilities include risk management, configuration management, and budget and cost analysis, release support, and assessment and authorization support to VA IT development/ sustainment project(s).  

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do. **TISTA** associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account \& Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short\-term \& Long\-term Disability, 401K Match, Professional development reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!
Responsibilities:
* Provide day\-to\-day management guidance and direction to project personnel in the execution of tasks defined in the PWS.
* Use proven project management and software development methodologies, including Large\-Scale Scrum (LeSS), SAFe, VIP and Process Asset Library (PAL) that assure that all contract\-driven activities are identified, documented, and tracked so that the contract shall continuously be evaluated and monitored for timely and quality service.
* Proactively monitor the performance of Programs and Program\-related Projects.
* Provide expert SME input to PMO and client leadership that will improve the overall maturity of the PMO and programs responsible for.
* Manage team assignments and oversee daily tasking of project teams in close collaboration with Scrum Masters.
* Maintain and improve Program/project related process documents in the PM Playbook.
* Act as primary interface with the client and ensure client’s needs are met within the scope of this project and our contract.
* Provide project financial and resource management to ensure programs/projects are staffed adequately to meet all time\-lines and requirements in scope.
* Identify, communicate, mitigate and manage project risks; provide weekly updates to Portfolio Risk Manager on issues/risks requiring escalation.
* Manage resources and project to cost, schedule and performance, aligned with time\-lines established in the Project schedule, prepare weekly resource utilization reports and monitor progress.
* Prepare and deliver on time input to contractual deliverables such dashboards, pipeline, and monthly status reports.
* Provide quality assurance over program/project deliverables and ensure timely submission of all contractual deliverables.
* Participate in PI\-Planning sessions and support Portfolio Director as required and keep the tap on project life\-cycle within the programs and ROI tracking for service line managers.
* Apply scaled lean agile methodology and framework (SAFe).
* Manage the project in compliance with VA’s Veteran\-focused Integration Process (VIP) governance model.
* Manage multiple projects aligned with the program/service line.
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of full systems development life cycle, enterprise\-wide network engineering, strategic information planning, business process re\-engineering, structure and management practices.


Qualifications:
* Minimum 10 years’ experience required.
* 5 years of experience leading a program using Large\-Scale Scrum (LeSS) and SAFe.
* Experience managing program management tasks within VA, specifically working knowledge of VA’s VIP management process.
* Knowledge of methodologies, technologies, frameworks, and toolsets such as Agile methodology, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Pega technology, VIP, Project Management Institute Project Management. Body of Knowledge, Lean Six Sigma (LSS), and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) technology.
* Deep understanding of scaled agile development methodologies (SAFe).

**Education:*** Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems, Business or related scientific /technical discipline.
* Additional 8 years’ relevant experience may be substituted for Bachelor’s degree.
* Certified in Leading SAFe 4\.5 (or higher) (nice to have).
* Certified Project Management Professional (PMP).
* Certified Scrum Master (preferred).

**Clearance:**

* Ability to obtain Moderate Background Investigation (MBI) clearance.

**Location:**

* Remote, USA.

 **Pay Range:*** The pay for this position ranges from $65,234 to $73,645\.
* The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
* Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.
* TISTA associates are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits plan! More information can be found here: https://tistatech.com/working\-at\-tista/

This role will be remote/virtual and requires the ability to travel. US citizenship is required.

* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with Federal government customers and stakeholders
* Assist with the development of MBS’s Federal acquisition strategy
* Diligently monitor project progress using work plan and project plan tools
* Assist with execution of contracts, contract modifications, and subcontractor agreements
* Lead internal and external project meetings
* Familiarity with Federal Government security policies and procedures
* Monitor and effectively communicate project status and issues to management and present options for issue resolution
* Monitor resource allocation and labor expenditures across projects
* Other duties as assigned.

* Comprehensive understanding of federal contract vehicles and compliance requirements
* Experience managing, implementing, and supporting National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) security guidelines for clients
* Understanding of Prime and Subcontractor regulations related to Federal contracts
* Ability to work independently and drive initiatives forward effectively with little supervision
* Business development mindset and ability to think creatively when exploring growth opportunities

* Ability to provide leadership/mentorship to other team members

jobs.title: Project Manager IT
jobs.description:
**Project Manager IT**


Remote


Full Time


Travel Less than 10%  

  

**JOB SUMMARY**  

MAP International is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our IT team and lead delivery of the projects driving our technology transformation. This role owns planning, coordination, and execution across concurrent initiatives — including cloud migration to AWS, Salesforce CRM implementation, and related systems and process work — keeping scope, schedule, budget, and risk visible to stakeholders at every level. The ideal candidate brings a track record of shipping technology projects on time in a resource\-conscious environment, communicates clearly with both technical and non\-technical partners, and is enthusiastic about using AI tools to work faster and better. Above all, this person is motivated by the chance to apply strong delivery discipline to a global humanitarian mission.
  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  

**Project Planning and Execution**  

* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables for concurrent technology and operational initiatives
* Define project scope and success criteria with sponsors, and manage change control when scope shifts
* Coordinate cross\-functional project teams, internal staff, and external vendors to keep work moving against committed dates
* Track task ownership, dependencies, and blockers, and drive issues to resolution
* Maintain project documentation including charters, status reports, decision logs, and post\-implementation reviews


Stakeholder Communication and Reporting
  

* Provide regular status reporting to leadership, translating technical detail into clear business impact
* Facilitate project meetings, working sessions, and steering committee updates, and publish decisions and action items
* Partner with department leaders to gather requirements, confirm priorities, and manage expectations on timelines and trade\-offs
* Support change management and end\-user readiness activities, including training coordination and communication plans.

**Risk, Budget, and Vendor Management**  

* Identify, document, and actively manage project risks, assumptions, and constraints, escalating with recommended options
* Track project budgets, forecasts, and actuals in partnership with IT and Finance
* Manage vendor and implementation\-partner deliverables, statements of work, and timelines
* Monitor resource capacity across projects and flag conflicts before they affect delivery


Process Improvement and AI\-Enabled Delivery
  

* Establish and improve repeatable project management practices, templates, and reporting standards for the organization
* Apply AI tools to routine project work such as drafting status updates, summarizing meetings and documentation, analyzing project data, and automating recurring tasks
* Share effective AI practices with colleagues and help identify where AI can reduce manual effort in project and operational workflows
* Contribute to continuous improvement of intake, prioritization, and portfolio visibility processes

**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**  

This position reports to the Chief Operations and Information Officer and works collaboratively across the organization. Internally, the Project Manager partners with IT team members on technical delivery and release planning, works with program, operations, logistics, development, and finance staff to gather requirements and coordinate project activities, and provides leadership with clear visibility into project status, risk, and resource needs. The role influences and coordinates work across teams without direct supervisory authority and adapts communication for both technical and non\-technical audiences. Externally, the Project Manager manages implementation partners, consultants, and technology vendors, coordinates schedules and deliverables with those partners, and may interface with partner organizations such as NGOs and healthcare providers on projects that affect shared systems and data exchange in support of MAP's global medicine distribution mission.
  

**QUALIFICATIONS**  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  

**Required Qualifications**  

* Proven experience working in a nonprofit or mission\-driven organization
* 5\+ years of experience managing projects end to end, including scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholder communication
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and shared resources
* Experience leading technology or systems implementation projects, such as platform migrations, CRM or ERP rollouts, or integration work
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional teams and external vendors without direct supervisory authority
* Evidence of using AI tools in day\-to\-day work, and enthusiasm for applying AI to improve project delivery and team productivity
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting status and risk to executive audiences

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* PMP certification

jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst III - Temporary position
jobs.description:
About Crisis24
  
Crisis24 is a global, AI\-enhanced provider of travel risk management, mass communications, critical event management, crisis\-security consulting, personal protection solutions and global medical concierge capabilities, allowing prominent organizations, disruptive brands and influential people to operate with confidence in an uncertain world. Backed by proprietary AI\-enabled SaaS technologies, advanced Global Operations Centers, an extensive global footprint, and the largest team of private\-sector intelligence analysts in the world, we deliver localized insights and global perspectives alongside medical, security, crisis response, embedded intelligence, and consultancy services as a preferred partner for Fortune 500 corporations.
  
At Crisis24, we don't just offer jobs – we offer missions. We recruit the very best from the military, intelligence agencies, academia, law enforcement, medicine, or any of our areas of specialty. We protect more than places. We protect people, reputations, and lifestyles, with integrity, discipline, discretion, and purpose. Whether you're stepping into civilian life after service, seeking personal or professional growth, or bringing specialized expertise to a higher calling, we match your ambition with real opportunity. Do the most important work of your career, helping safeguard the world's most important organizations and individuals against risk.
  
More information is available at https://www.crisis24\.com/careers
  
  

Who We Are Looking For
  
  

Under the general direction of the Embedded Intelligence Services (EIS) department, the Intelligence Analyst III will support the analytical needs of a major client engagement. The Analyst will work directly with their Manager and the EIS team to produce analysis that addresses client\-specific requirements. The Analyst will be available to travel to client locations as needed. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required on a case\-by\-case basis. This role is based at the Crisis24 Annapolis, MD office or remote, and is a temporary remote position starting mid\-September 2026 through mid\-January 2027\.
  
  

What You Will Work On
  
  

In coordination with Crisis24 EIS Managers, and in accordance with appropriate guidance: actively monitors open\-source media, third\-party subscription services, and other sources in real time for issues that could affect business operations and personnel; open\-source intelligence collection and analysis of regional trends and events to provide timely, comprehensive, customized intelligence products to decision makers; develops client\-specific intelligence products including, but not limited to: Travel Threat Assessments, Location Threat Assessments (Neighborhood\-, City\-, or Country\-level), Site Threat Assessments, Event Threat Assessments, Requests for Intelligence, Daily Incident Assessments or Intelligence Products, Threat Forecasting, Scenario Forecasting, Social Media Monitoring, Online Exposure Assessments; liaise with the client to better understand their requirements and concerns, and understand the client’s operational footprint; manages client expectations by understanding the EIS team's product offerings and limitations; Establishing and maintaining positive professional rapport with other analysts and SME as well as client contacts; supports manager in tracking metrics around production; and assists in managing emergency incidents by using judgment and skills in accordance with commonly accepted incident management best practices and client policies and procedures.
  
  

What You Will Bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in intelligence analysis, threat assessment, incident response, or a related field required
* Excellent research skills and the ability to mentor analysts in how to research and evaluate sources.
* Exceptional analytic writing skills and the ability to mentor other analysts in analytic writing.
* Excellent verbal briefing skills and the ability to mentor other analysts in verbal briefing.
* Ability to mentor other analysts in analytic skills.
* Subject matter expertise in a location, security\-related topic, or analytic process is a bonus.
* Foreign language and travel experience required.
* Customer service experience required; ability to support complex engagements a plus.
* Experience overseeing other analysts' work is a plus.
* Experience leading projects with several other analysts.
* Effective problem\-solving skills.
* Fast learner and ability to multitask.
* Ability to organize and prioritize work with little supervision.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Knowledge of Google Earth and Maps.


Important Note About This Position
  
  

This is a temporary remote position starting mid\-September 2026 and ending mid\-January 2027\. This position focuses on geopolitical risk, global threat intelligence, and monitoring events that could disrupt client operations, including political, economic, social, and security factors, as well as natural events such as severe weather and other disasters. The role emphasizes qualitative research, investigative analysis, and intelligence reporting rather than technical, IT, cybersecurity, data analytics, or business intelligence functions. Potential applicants with primary experience in technical or data\-centric fields should carefully consider whether this role aligns with their background.
  
  

**Note:** This is a temporary position starting mid\-September 2026 and ending mid\-January 2027
  
* Flexible hours and workdays are required to meet Crisis24's core 24/7 mission.
* Required to be available to travel to client locations as needed.
* Candidates will be asked to pass a background check as well as writing and technology aptitude screenings as a condition of employment.


Information Security
  
* Protect the data and systems of Crisis24

**Information Security Analyst**  

  

*Salary: $95,000 to $140,000 per year*  

  

*Security Clearance: Public Trust*  

Ops Tech Alliance (OTA) is a leading provider of cybersecurity solutions dedicated to protecting critical infrastructure and sensitive data. We are committed to excellence and innovation, and we take pride in supporting initiatives that enhance national security, such as cybersecurity competitions and cyber training events.


We are seeking a skilled and motivated Information Security Analyst with a specific focus on developing cybersecurity challenges for cyber competitions. This role involves creating and executing competition challenges, developing challenges, and applying the skills and knowledge gained to enhance our cybersecurity operations.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Plan, design, and develop innovative and challenging scenarios, ensuring they are realistic, engaging, and technically demanding.
* Execute and oversee the event, ensuring smooth operation and addressing any technical issues that arise.
* Collaborate with team members to ensure the challenges are comprehensive and align with current cybersecurity trends and threats.
* Analyze feedback and results from the competition to refine and improve future iterations of the competition.
* Provide technical support throughout the program lifecycle
* Build and containerize challenge environments using Docker and Docker Compose, producing images and multi\-service stacks that deploy reliably and reproducibly on competition infrastructure.
* Develop automated setup, grading, and flag\-handling logic for each challenge, and test end\-to\-end for correctness, idempotent reset, and resource limits under competition load.
* Maintain challenge source, artifacts, and solution guides in version control, and prepare challenges for peer review and public release.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest cybersecurity trends, threats, and technologies to ensure competition challenges remain relevant and challenging.
* Conduct regular security assessments and audits to identify potential vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Develop and maintain security policies, procedures, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry standards, best practices, and relevant compliance frameworks.


**Qualifications**


* Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. Will consider relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in information security or a related role.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, practices, and technologies.
* Experience with cybersecurity competitions is highly desirable.
* Proficiency in security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and endpoint protection.
* Familiar with modern development workflows and tools, such as Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and version control systems.
* Hands\-on proficiency with Docker and Docker Compose, including writing Dockerfiles, composing multi\-service networks and volumes, managing images and registries, and hardening containers.
* Strong Linux and Windows system administration skills, with solid networking fundamentals (DNS, routing, firewalls, TLS, packet analysis) and service configuration.
* Scripting and development ability in Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell for challenge tooling, environment automation, and grading scripts.
* Familiarity with virtualization and infrastructure\-as\-code (VMware, Proxmox, KVM, Terraform, Ansible) for building repeatable lab and range environments.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to think critically under pressure.
* Understanding of workforce development frameworks such as NICE.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
* Experience in developing and designing cybersecurity challenges or CTF (Capture The Flag) competitions is highly desirable.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, or GIAC are a plus.

  

  

  

Ops Tech Alliance (OTA) was founded by former National Security and Special Operations professionals with over 100 years of combined experience and was formed with a singular focus: to bridge the gap between operations and technology to enable mission success. jobs.description:
**Connexus Credit Union \- Who We Are:**


Serving members across all 50 states, Connexus Credit Union is a member\-focused cooperative that is proud to return profits to member\-owners through high yields for checking accounts and deposit products, as well as competitive rates on our loans. We are a remote first employer with the majority of our employees residing in the upper Midwest.


As an employer we foster collaboration and high performance to achieve excellence. We holistically care for and develop our employees to thrive personally and professionally. We are proud to share our success with our employees and those we serve.

**Connexus offers an Amazing Benefits package:**

* 25 days of paid time off and 10 paid holidays

* Excellent Health, Dental, Vision insurance, including multiple plan options

* Employer paid Life insurance, Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability
* Tuition Reimbursement from $4,000 \- $7,000 per calendar year

**About the Role:**


The HR Data Analyst will partner with HR and business leaders to turn workforce data into insights that help inform decisions and improve the employee experience. This role will build and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics that provide meaningful visibility into key workforce trends and metrics. They will evaluate data across the employee lifecycle, identify opportunities for improvement, and share recommendations that support organizational goals. In addition, they will help ensure data quality, streamline reporting processes, and expand the organization's use of people analytics.

**Responsibilities:**


HR Analytics Strategy, Reporting, \& Dashboard Ownership

* Lead the development, maintenance, and optimization of HR dashboards, scorecards, and automated reporting solutions that provide meaningful insights across the employee lifecycle.
* Design, implement, and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to talent acquisition, employee engagement, retention, learning and development, total rewards, and HR operations.
* Ensure analytics solutions align with organizational priorities, strategic objectives, and the organization’s Employer of Choice commitment.
* Develop data visualizations and reporting tools tailored to both technical and non\-technical audiences, enabling leaders to make informed, data\-driven decisions.


Data Analysis \& Strategic Insights

* Conduct complex analyses of workforce data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities across all areas of Human Resources.
* Apply advanced analytical techniques, statistical methods, and predictive modeling to solve complex HR business challenges and support strategic decision\-making.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
* Research internal and external workforce trends, labor market conditions, and industry benchmarks to provide meaningful comparative insights.

Employee Experience \& Listening

* Measure and monitor employee sentiment, engagement, and experience through surveys, listening strategies, and workforce feedback mechanisms.
* Analyze employee lifecycle metrics to identify opportunities that strengthen attraction, engagement, development, and retention.
* Partner with HR leaders to evaluate the effectiveness of employee programs, initiatives, and organizational strategies.

Stakeholder Partnership \& Consultation

* Collaborate with HR, business leaders, Finance, and other stakeholders to define business needs, establish analytical priorities, and deliver impactful solutions.
* Present findings, trends, and recommendations through compelling storytelling, visualizations, and executive\-level presentations.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on workforce data, analytics methodologies, and KPI development.

Data Governance, Process Improvement, \& Compliance

* Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and consistency of HR data through validation, auditing, and ongoing quality assurance practices.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate reporting, streamline workflows, and improve data management processes.
* Maintain compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, privacy standards, and organizational policies related to HR data and reporting.

**Position Requirements:**

* This position is Remote.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field is Required.
* 5\+ years of experience in HR analytics, people analytics, business intelligence, or a related analytical role is Required.
* Advanced proficiency in Workday, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, or other data visualization and reporting tools is Required.
* Demonstrated experience building dashboards, developing KPIs, and automating reporting processes is Required.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to interpret complex data and translate insights into business recommendation is Required.
* Experience working with large, complex datasets, including data cleansing, validation, integration, and modeling is Required.

* 2026 Best Place to Work in IT, Computer World

*Equal Opportunity* *Employer/Disabled/Veterans/41* *CFR 60–1\.4, 41 CFR 60\-1\.35*

This is not a technical systems analyst role. Experience with accounting and financial systems such as Blackline, Kyriba, Guidewire, or similar platforms is required.

**Preferred Qualifications*** CPA certification.

The successful candidate will be viewed as a trusted advisor by business stakeholders, a strong advocate for accounting users, and a key contributor to transformation initiatives. jobs.title: Broadcast & Media Technology Project Manager
jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY**


Fox News Media
FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct\-to\-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.**JOB DESCRIPTION**
-------------------


FOX News Media is seeking an experienced Broadcast \& Media Technology Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across studio operations, live broadcast production, contribution/transmission networks, Media Asset Management (MAM) pipelines, and fast\-turnaround content creation/editing environments.


This role will manage projects from initial discovery and technical requirements gathering through solution delivery, systems integration, testing, commissioning, and transition to 24/7 broadcast operations. The successful candidate will collaborate closely across broadcast engineering, studio operations, control rooms, post\-production, editorial, transmission, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and external systems integrators/vendors.


The ideal candidate combines disciplined project management practices with a strong technical understanding of how broadcast content moves from field capture/ingest through studio control rooms, non\-linear editing (NLE) suites, central MAM repositories, master control/playout, and multi\-path transmission.

**A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES**
--------------------------------------

### **Project Delivery and Governance**

* Lead the full project lifecycle, including discovery, scoping, technical design coordination, procurement, installation, integration, testing, commissioning, cutover, hypercare, and operational handover.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering work breakdown structures, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, hardware/software lead times, risks, issues, and capital/operating budgets.
* Establish governance routines, engineering working sessions, steering committee reporting, and change\-control decision forums.
* Coordinate workstreams across broadcast engineering, studio tech, transmission/traffic, newsroom operations, editing/post\-production, IT infrastructure, and third\-party vendors/systems integrators.
* Track delivery against broadcast milestones, schedule, budget, quality standards, and operational\-readiness criteria.
* Maintain rigorous project documentation, including functional specs, system schematics coordination, rack elevations, acceptance test plans (ATP), cutover runbooks, and handover documentation.

### **Broadcast \& Media Technology Delivery**

* Lead initiatives involving production switchers, audio consoles, studio cameras, robotics, multi\-viewers, tally/intercom systems (e.g., Riedel, RTS), broadcast graphics (e.g., Vizrt), and virtual/augmented reality studio tech.
* Oversee deployments for field acquisition, bonded cellular (e.g., LiveU, Dejero), satellite/fiber contribution, IP contribution protocols (SRT, RIST, Zixi), and baseband/IP ingest pipelines.
* Manage MAM implementations, metadata schema standardization, ingest automation, nearline/deep archive tiers, LTO/cloud storage lifecycles, and media supply chain orchestration.
* Drive technical delivery for non\-linear editing (NLE) platforms (Adobe Premiere, Avid Media Composer), shared production storage (SAN/NAS/Isilon/Avid NEXIS), fast\-turnaround news editing, and transcode/QC workflows.
* Coordinate projects for playout automation, routing matrices (SDI and IP), primary/backup transmission paths, satellite uplink/downlink, terrestrial fiber circuits, and disaster recovery (DR) facilities.
* Facilitate technical integration between newsroom systems (e.g., iNEWS, ENPS), rundown automation, prompters, and playback servers.
* Translate operational and editorial requirements into clear engineering workstreams and technical deliverables.
* Support infrastructure modernization and technology refreshes, such as SDI\-to\-ST 2110 IP transitions, cloud\-assisted production, and hybrid on\-prem/cloud workflows.
* Coordinate technical design reviews alongside Principal Engineers, Systems Architects, and Technical Leads.

### **Live Operations, Commissioning \& Deployment Readiness**

* Plan and direct factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), end\-to\-end rehearsal workflows, operational shadow periods, cutovers, and rollback strategies.
* Schedule and oversee maintenance windows and deployment sequencing to ensure zero disruption to on\-air linear feeds and 24/7 live studio operations.
* Partner with Broadcast Operations and Engineering teams to establish support escalation models, monitoring/telemetry dashboards, signal path redundancies, runbooks, and SOPs.
* Coordinate comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer for operators, directors, editors, engineers, and technicians prior to on\-air cutover.

### **Technology Modernization \& Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with engineering leads to evaluate emerging broadcast standards (SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, NDI) and cloud/virtualized production platforms.
* Identify workflow bottlenecks in the content creation and turnaround pipeline, introducing automation for ingest, transcode, QC, and archiving.
* Promote standard operating procedures and best\-practice deployment frameworks across all broadcast and studio facilities.

**WHAT YOU WILL NEED**

* Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Media Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical industry experience.
* Technology project management experience, with experience directly managing broadcast engineering, studio facility, transmission

We are seeking an experienced **EHR Integration \& Implementation Project Manager** to oversee the consolidation of six operating companies onto a single ClinicMind EHR platform. The ideal candidate will have experience managing complex healthcare technology implementations, including EHR integrations, data migration, vendor coordination, testing, and go\-live support. This individual should be a strong project leader who can manage multiple workstreams, collaborate across technical and operational teams, and communicate effectively with senior leadership  


**Scope of Services**  


**1\. Enterprise EHR Integration Oversight**  


* Lead and oversee the implementation of ClinicMind across six companies.
* Develop and maintain the overall implementation timeline, milestones, and deliverables.
* Coordinate meetings with stakeholders, ClinicMind implementation teams, and third\-party vendors.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies.
* Ensure implementation activities remain on schedule and within agreed project objectives.

**2\. Referral Portal Build \& Integration**  


* Oversee the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of the ClinicMind referral portal.
* Coordinate integration with referral partners and internal workflows.
* Validate referral processes for accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.
* Manage issue resolution during implementation and post\-launch stabilization.

* Oversee integration between ClinicMind scheduling functionality and the organization's websites.
* Coordinate with web developers, ClinicMind technical teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure appointment scheduling workflows function accurately and efficiently.
* Supervise user acceptance testing and deployment.

**4\. AI Receptionist Deployment**  


* Manage the implementation and rollout of the AI receptionist solution.
* Coordinate system configuration, call routing, scripting, scheduling integration, and workflow automation.
* Ensure the AI receptionist integrates effectively with ClinicMind scheduling and patient communication workflows.
* Oversee testing, staff training, and go\-live support.

**5\. Data Migration Oversight**  


* Coordinate the migration of patient and operational data from legacy EHR systems and other data sources into ClinicMind.
* Oversee data mapping, validation, cleansing, and migration testing.
* Ensure data integrity, completeness, and compliance throughout the migration process.
* Coordinate reconciliation efforts and resolve migration\-related issues prior to final go\-live.

**Project Management Responsibilities**  


* Serve as the primary implementation oversight lead across all workstreams.
* Maintain project documentation, status reports, action items, and risk logs.
* Provide regular executive updates regarding project status, risks, and key decisions.
* Facilitate cross\-functional communication among leadership, operations, IT, vendors, and implementation teams.
* Escalate critical issues and recommend solutions to maintain project momentum.

* Comprehensive implementation project plan.
* Integrated project timeline with milestones and dependencies.
* Weekly project status reports.
* Risk and issue tracking log.
* Data migration readiness and validation reports.
* Referral portal implementation oversight.
* Website scheduling integration oversight.
* AI receptionist implementation oversight.
* Go\-live readiness assessment.
* Post\-implementation stabilization support and transition documentation.

**Expected Outcomes**  


* Successful implementation of ClinicMind across all six companies.
* Standardized EHR workflows across the organization.
* Fully operational referral portal.
* Seamless website appointment scheduling integrated with ClinicMind.
* Successful deployment of the AI receptionist solution.
* Accurate migration of legacy data into ClinicMind.

The consultant will report directly to the COO and provide regular progress updates, identify implementation risks, recommend corrective actions, and coordinate all implementation activities with ClinicMind and other project stakeholders.

**Preferred**

Firstrade Securities is a U.S. retail brokerage serving investors globally. We're hiring an Associate Data Analyst to support data and reporting needs across the firm — product, marketing, operations, compliance, and executive leadership.

This is a hands\-on, execution\-focused role reporting directly to our senior data analyst, who will mentor you closely. You'll own the recurring reports and dashboards that different teams rely on day to day, handle ad hoc data requests, and grow into more advanced analytical work over time.

It's an ideal role for someone with 1–2 years of analytics experience — ideally in finance, brokerage, or fintech — who wants to sharpen their technical skills and learn the brokerage business from the inside.

jobs.title: IT Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

  

**About Natixis**

At Natixis, we shape the future of global finance. As a leading international financial services firm, we deliver innovative solutions, tailored expertise, and diverse investment strategies to our corporate, institutional, and sovereign clients worldwide. We foster a collaborative, dynamic, and inclusive culture where top talent can thrive, grow, and make a meaningful impact. Join our team and help us drive excellence in global banking.

  

**Business Analyst – IT Global Banking**

**Position Overview** We are seeking a highly skilled, motivated, and detail\-oriented Business Analyst to join our IT Global Banking team. In this critical role, you will provide essential support to our Global Banking Operations clients, ensuring the seamless performance and stability of our core financial systems.

  

This position is ideal for a professional who possesses a deep understanding of global finance and trade finance processes, combined with a proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues, analyze user needs, and maintain system integrity. Rather than focusing on large\-scale implementations, this role offers the opportunity to become a key subject matter expert, driving continuous improvement through system maintenance, support of existing processes, and hands\-on, high\-impact system evolutions.

  

Additionally, we offer a hybrid work model, allowing you to balance remote work and in\-office collaboration seamlessly.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

As a Business Analyst, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technological solutions. Your day\-to\-day responsibilities will include:


* **Incident Resolution \& Support:** Analyzing incidents and technical anomalies to identify root causes, troubleshooting system issues, and actively working to resolve technical challenges.
* **Application Expertise:** Assisting Operations users with the functionality of key industry applications, specifically FBTI and Loan IQ.
* **Knowledge Management:** Authoring comprehensive "How\-To" documentation and building a robust local Support Library to empower team members and streamline future troubleshooting.
* **Requirements Gathering:** Collaborating with diverse stakeholders across various Global Banking business units (including Trade Finance, Payments, and Lending) to elicit, analyze, and document detailed business requirements.
* **Documentation Excellence:** Developing high\-quality business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications documents (FSDs), user stories, use cases, and process flows.
* **Data Analysis \& Visualization:** Utilizing Power BI and data analysis tools to create dynamic visualizations and reports that support the Global Banking Operations team.
* **Process Mapping:** Creating detailed process flow diagrams of present\-state operations and future\-state developments to visualize workflows and system designs.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Facilitating interactive workshops and meetings with cross\-functional teams to gather valuable insights, align expectations, and drive collaborative problem\-solving.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identifying strategic opportunities to optimize IT systems and processes to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and elevate the overall user experience.
  

**Qualifications**

To thrive in this role, you should bring a blend of financial expertise, technical acumen, and exceptional interpersonal skills:


* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in finance, business administration, computer science, or a related field; a master's degree is preferred.
* **Experience:** A minimum of 5 years of professional experience in global banking, financial services, or a closely related environment.
* **Systems Knowledge:** Direct hands\-on experience with Loan IQ, FBTI software, or equivalent global banking and lending platforms.
* **Domain Expertise:** Strong, comprehensive knowledge of global banking products, trade finance, payments, and lending operations.
* **Technical \& Analytical Skills:** Advanced proficiency in data analysis tools (such as Power BI), writing SQL queries, and manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
* **Leadership \& Communication:** Effective written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to lead discussions, influence stakeholders, and independently drive topics to successful completion.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Sharp analytical capabilities with a keen attention to detail and a passion for diagnosing and resolving complex system behaviors.

  

The salary range for this position will be between $110,000 \- 145,000\. Natixis is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Actual base salary will vary and will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, education, skills set, applicable licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Base salary is only one component of our total rewards package. Natixis also offers a generous benefits package, and you may be eligible for a discretionary incentive award depending on company and individual performance.

jobs.description:
#### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**



At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.  

  

Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

**Your Impact**



As an Accounting Operations Sr. Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate and complete financial reporting through the monthly close process, including GL consolidation and intercompany eliminations. You will work cross\-functionally across Controllership, FP\&A, and IT teams to support close activities, strengthen internal controls, and drive in\-depth analytics over operating expenses. This role will also be instrumental in supporting the rollout of our new OneStream consolidation tool, partnering closely with the Financial Systems and Analytics team to help design, test, and adopt improved close and reporting processes. This role is well\-suited for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, evolving environment and enjoys applying technical accounting expertise, analytical thinking, and collaboration to drive high\-quality financial reporting.


**Work Location**



Hybrid Presence based in one of U.S. hubs: Boston, NY, Seattle, Scottsdale. This role follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in\-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in\-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.


**What You'll Do**


* Support monthly and quarterly close activities, including GL consolidation, intercompany eliminations, and account reconciliations across multiple entities
* Perform in\-depth analytical reviews of operating expenses, identifying trends, variances, and opportunities to improve accuracy and efficiency
* Prepare and review flux analysis over the P\&L and Balance Sheet, partnering with FP\&A and business partners to explain key drivers of variance
* Support the rollout and adoption of OneStream, including data validation, process design, and monthly close reviews within the new consolidation tool
* Partner cross\-functionally with Accounting Operations, Revenue Accounting, FP\&A, and IT to ensure consolidated results are accurate, timely, and well\-documented
* Prepare and record journal entries related to consolidations, eliminations, and other close activities
* Assist in strengthening internal controls throughout the close process, including execution of key SOX controls and documentation of procedures
* Identify and drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and system enhancements to reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets and improve close efficiency
* Support internal and external audits by providing requested documentation, reconciliations, and analysis
* Assist with special projects and ad hoc analyses as needed, including support for finance transformation initiatives


**What You Bring**


* Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance (or equivalent experience)
* CPA designation or progress toward CPA preferred
* 3–6\+ years of accounting experience, with GL consolidation experience strongly preferred
* Highly analytical, with strong experience performing flux and variance analysis over the P\&L and Balance Sheet
* Experience with consolidation and ERP tools; hands\-on experience with OneStream, HFM, or similar consolidation platforms is a plus
* Strong understanding of intercompany accounting and elimination processes in a multi\-entity environment
* Experience in a SaaS, technology, or multi\-national environment is a plus
* Experience partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders, including FP\&A, IT, and International Controllership teams
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills
* High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with evolving processes and systems
* Advanced Excel skills; experience with data analytics tools, Power BI, or reporting automation tools is a plus
* Self\-starter who can work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team
* Ability to influence, build consensus, and drive continuous improvement

#### **Benefits that Benefit You**

* Discretionary paid time off
* Paid parental leave for all

* Fitness Programs

* And yes, we have snacks in our offices

We are seeking an experienced Financial Education Program Manager \& Lead Facilitator to support the development and delivery of a statewide financial literacy program serving young adults participating in workforce and service\-based programs throughout. This role combines strong financial subject\-matter expertise with engaging facilitation skills to make complex financial topics accessible and practical. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing program activities, designing educational content and leading interactive sessions that empower young adults to make informed financial decisions. This paid position offers an opportunity to impact the financial well\-being of youth across the region through innovative education and facilitation.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, plan, and oversee the implementation of a comprehensive statewide financial literacy program tailored to young adults in workforce and service programs
* Design engaging, understandable, and practical financial education curricula that simplify complex topics such as budgeting, saving, credit management, and financial planning
* Lead dynamic facilitation sessions, workshops, and seminars that foster active participation and learning among diverse young adult audiences both virtual and on\-site
* Support the recruitment, training, and supervision of additional facilitators or educators involved in the program
* Collaborate with community partners, stakeholders, and organizations to ensure program relevance and expand outreach efforts
* Monitor program effectiveness through evaluation tools, feedback collection, and data analysis; use insights to improve content delivery
