* Stay informed on current financial trends, resources, and best practices to ensure content remains accurate and impactful
* Promote a positive learning environment that encourages questions, discussion, and practical application of financial concepts

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in financial education or related fields with a strong understanding of personal finance topics
* Exceptional facilitation skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences effectively
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex financial concepts into clear, accessible language suitable for young adults
* Experience developing educational curricula or training materials tailored for youth or adult learners
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written with a professional demeanor
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team setting
* Knowledge of local community resources and networks relevant to workforce development is preferred
* Commitment to empowering young adults through practical financial literacy education

**Experience**

* Minimum of **3 years of experience providing financial literacy, financial education, financial capability training, or closely related financial education services**
* Experience conducting financial education workshops, presentations, training sessions, or one\-on\-one financial education
* Experience educating **young adults, young business owners, workforce development participants, service\-program participants, or similar populations**
* Strong knowledge of personal financial topics including budgeting, banking, credit, debt, saving, taxes, and financial planning
* Demonstrated ability to facilitate both in\-person and virtual training sessions
* Comfortable presenting to both small and large groups
* Experience developing or customizing educational curriculum, presentations, participant materials, or training resources
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organizational and program coordination skills
* Ability to communicate financial concepts clearly to individuals with varying levels of financial knowledge
* Ability and willingness to travel to training locations throughout Maryland

**Preferred Background**

Candidates with professional experience in one or more of the following areas are strongly encouraged to apply:

* Accounting
* Tax preparation or tax advisory
* Financial education
* Financial coaching
* Financial counseling
* Banking or financial services
* Small\-business financial advising
* Workforce development
* Adult education
* Nonprofit financial leadership

jobs.title: Data Governance Program Analyst
jobs.description:
*Looking for big consulting firm experience but with all the advantages of a small company? Join the Vergys Team!*
Vergys is seeking a highly skilled, experienced Program Analyst – Data Governance to join us in a long\-term, full\-time, mostly remote opportunity supporting a Federal contract. In this role, you will support the daily operations of an information governance program, providing program coordination, documentation, data stewardship, operational analysis, and executive\-level reporting. You will play a key role in sustaining data quality, governance documentation, and decision\-support materials that help program leadership operate efficiently and with confidence.  

**Core Job Responsibilities**

* Experience developing and maintaining SOPs, business cases, guidance, and decision\-support documentation.
* Experience conducting root cause analyses and current\-state/future\-state operational assessments.

jobs.title: HVAC Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Occupational Summary**

Baumann Consulting, Inc. (Baumann), with offices in Washington, D.C., Chicago, and Frankfurt (Germany), provides consulting services for sustainable and innovative building solutions for the US and international markets. We provide sound engineering practices and creative solutions. Baumann Consulting is a highly reputable transatlantic consultancy for sustainability and energy efficiency in the real estate industry.

**Our mission is to deliver solutions for a carbon\-neutral real estate industry.**

We are seeking an **HVAC Project Manager** to plan, coordinate, and deliver HVAC and associated mechanical system projects that support high‑performing, efficient, and resilient buildings. HVAC Project Managers are thrilled to dig deep into buildings and their mechanical systems and work mostly independently on complex projects while collaborating closely with clients, contractors, and internal teams. They apply sound engineering judgment, adapt standard practices, and develop effective solutions to technical and operational challenges, supported by an experienced multidisciplinary team.

**Job Description and Key Responsibilities**

The overall objective of this position is to plan, coordinate, and deliver mechanical systems projects related to HVAC with a strong focus on quality, cost effectiveness, and client satisfaction.

**Main responsibilities of the Project Manager include (but are not limited to):**

* Manage energy efficiency related projects, deferred maintenance resolution, and comfort or domestic water system improvements.
* Obtain and evaluate contractor quotes, proposals, and cost estimates.
* Lead troubleshooting efforts and coordinate resolution of system performance issues.
* Witness testing, inspections, and system verification activities.
* Collect, analyze, and document technical data to support project decisions.
* Maintain direct responsibility for quality, schedule adherence, and cost effectiveness of all project deliverables.
* Prepare technical reports and project documentation for clients.
* Maintain regular, professional communication with clients, contractors, and project stakeholders.
* Lead and participate in in‑person client and contractor meetings, which represent the majority of project coordination activities.
* Support commissioning, sustainability, and benchmarking‑related tasks as assigned.
* Coordinate effectively with internal Baumann teams to ensure alignment with project objectives and firm standards.

**Requirements and Qualifications**

The position requires the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a consulting environment, with significant opportunities for professional growth within a growing organization.

**The following qualifications are required:**

* End‑user experience with multiple Building Automation Systems (BAS).
* Minimum of 5\+ years of experience in plant operations, construction management, commissioning, or building automation system installation or service.
* A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field may substitute for up to 2 years of required experience.
* In\-depth knowledge of common commercial HVAC systems and their components.
* Working knowledge of plumbing and electrical systems.
* Effective construction site communication skills.
* Must be able to meet eligibility requirements to access government facilities.
* Residency within the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area.
* Ability to work onsite up to 3–4 days per week at client sites within the Washington, D.C. and Baltimore metropolitan areas.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing and implementing successful energy efficiency measures.
* Familiarity with Building Energy Performance Standards (BEPS) programs in Washington, D.C., and Maryland.
* Master HAVC license
* DC 3rd Class Steam Operator license
* Certified Energy Manager certification

Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to undergo a background check, in accordance with local law/regulations?
* Do you have any HVAC\-related certifications?
* Will you now, or in the future, require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g. H\-1B visa status)?

Experience:

* Consutling: 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Washington, DC 20005

-----------


The position is located in the Architect of the Capitol (AOC), Superintendent, Senate Office Buildings (SOB). The incumbent serves as a Management and Program Analyst for the AOC Senate Jurisdiction and performs organizational reviews covering a range of services and subjects that enhance the performance of the SOB jurisdiction. Performs administrative functions, including compliance with human resource policies and procedures, workforce efficiency and conflict resolution intervention.


Learn more about this agency

-----------------------

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

----------------

* You must be able to pass a drug test.
* You must meet the definition of specialized experience.
* Appointment subject to background investigation and favorable adjudication.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager - Baltimore, MD
jobs.description:
**Job Location:** **Baltimore, MD**
**Position: Senior Project Manager**
**REQ ID: 12431**  

**OVERVIEW**  

For more than 100 years, Barton Malow has been committed to *Building People, Projects, and Communities*. Guided by our Core Values of Integrity, Partnership, and Empowerment, we’ve built a culture that supports strong leadership, collaboration, and long‑term career growth. We’re seeking an experienced Project Manager to support projects, leading teams through all phases of project delivery while ensuring safety, quality, schedule, and budget expectations are met. This position will be focused in the Baltimore, MD area.

The Project Manager is responsible for overseeing project execution from preconstruction through closeout, including procurement, planning, field operations, cost management, and team leadership. This role partners closely with superintendents, engineers, subcontractors, and design teams to deliver complex projects efficiently and successfully.



**KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Procurement**


* Develop bidders list, including ability to analyze information in CPS and be aware of local market capabilities
* Develop overall bidding strategy for project
* Manage distribution of bidding documents and tracking of bidders, including solicitation of bidders and management of data within CPS
* Organize and conduct pre\-bid meetings
* Manage bidder question process
* Manage development of work scopes and mentor others on their creation
* Develop front end documents for bidding based on project needs and requirements of owner contract
* Receive/evaluate bids and conduct post\-bid reviews
* Write subcontracts, both standard subcontract orders and more complex types such as professional services or design\-assist


**Planning**


* Initiate setup of a complex project schedule and creation of activities and logic, with no/little assistance on durations and schedule flow.
* Develop site logistics plans in conjunction with superintendent
* Set up a multi\-element cash flow and manpower projection analysis at varying stages of the project
* Prepare constructability reviews to determine completeness of documents
* Review estimates prepared by preconstruction group for potential scope holes
* Initiate set up of jobsite, including mobilization of trailer and setup of jobsite staff


**Field Operations**


* Establish and oversee the safety plan at the jobsite; set safety culture at jobsite
* Ensure punchlist process is completed in a timely manner
* Assist with management of labor relations with field personnel, including interactions with unions
* Implement emergency crisis procedures and ensure staff is appropriately trained
* Manage owner equipment coordination process
* Facilitate Mechanical/Electrical overhead coordination or BIM process


**Cost Management**


* Create and manage general conditions budget. Monitor and update projections monthly
* Establish non\-reimbursables based on interpretation of contract; work to minimize their usage
* Set up trade budget structure and log into Prolog
* Review budget entries of others and evaluate reports for accuracy
* Regularly monitor project costs and effectiveness of change management process
* Oversee creation of cost items in prolog and issuance to contractors
* Assist with processing changes to owner agreement
* Support job\-site cash management, including monitoring of job profitability and timeliness of payment


**Management**


* Facilitate meetings with the project team
* Ensure RFIs and submittals are being appropriately processed by the engineering staff
* Ensure office procedures are implemented, including filing system, correspondence formats, start\-up documents, closeout documents, and archiving
* Manage ultimate agency acceptance of the project, including serving as an interface to code officials
* Involvement in seeking repeat and new business sales
* Assist with response to RFPs and preparation of presentations for new projects
* Manage job relations and communication needs with the Architect/Engineer

  

  

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**  


* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline
* 8\+ years’ experience in GC/CM Construction Management
* Experience with Procore preferred
* Strong verbal and written communication skills


Job Type: Full\-time



Base Pay: $108,500 to 189,800 per year.



Benefits:


* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Annual Incentive Bonus plan
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off


The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.

We are seeking an exceptional leader to head our dynamic and innovative expansion into Mission Critical Facilities and Data Centers, under our Life \& Technology Sciences Platform. This pivotal role involves managing complex leading all business development activities for commercial real estate projects, delivering tailored solutions that exceed client expectations. The ideal candidate will serve as the main point of contact for clients, ensuring all aspects of the project engagements are handled with the highest level of professionalism and efficiency.

Professionalism and Integrity**:** Uphold high standards of professionalism and integrity, aiming for win\-win solutions while considering the interests of Cushman \& Wakefield, stakeholders, and the broader community.

* Ability to lead the sourcing, pitching, and securing of new business and projects.

* Strong leadership skills with the ability to act as a liaison across various departments and external partners.

* Commitment to professionalism, ethical standards, and innovative problem\-solving
* Demonstrates subject matter expertise in the development and completion aforementioned project types.
* Acts as the trusted business advisor and strategic partner by the clients both internally and externally.

**BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree in a Science or Mechanical and/or Electrical engineering disciplines. Advanced degrees are desirable.
* 5 to 10\+ years of Design and Construction industry experience in the aforementioned fields.
* 7\+ years of Commercial Real Estate Project Management experience with related experience in product development, launch, business process optimization, regulatory submission and/or regulatory compliance, and/or quality assurance.
* Proven track record with delivering complex commercial Real Estate and Design/Construction projects. Projects include Ground Up and Build\-To\-Suit projects, re\-positioning projects, renovations and repurposing projects, and other complex development projects.
* Experience with providing advanced projects controls solutions, including P3/Primavera and Cost and Budget Estimating solutions.
* Expertise with municipalities, economic development authorities, utility companies, and familiarity with zoning and entitlements processes, and dealings with complex land use issues.
* PMP and LEED Certificates preferred.
* Knowledge and application of a disciplined Project Management process (Six Sigma desirable).
* Demonstrated experience managing projects varying in size including strategic planning, demolition, new Construction and interior fit out, and/or Project controls solutions.

  



**COMPETENCIES**

* Extraordinary acumen for Business Development and Revenue Generation
* Complex Problem Solving, Functional and Business Strategy
* Develops new and unique ways to improve operations and processes that bring value
* Positively influences others to achieve results
* Leadership/ Managerial Courage
* Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills to effectively communicate and build relationsh

ASRC Federal is hiring a Cloud Threat Analyst in support of our Defense Counterintelligence Security Agency (DCSA) program based out of Hanover MD.

**Position Description:**  

As the Cloud Threat Analyst, your primary duty is to safeguard our national security systems through proactive threat hunting and advanced threat detection activities. You will continuously monitor and analyze threat intelligence sources to stay informed about emerging threats, searching for signs of malicious activity across our network infrastructure, endpoints, and systems that evade traditional security solutions. A key part of your role involves developing and implementing new and innovative threat detection techniques and strategies, analyzing large datasets to identify patterns and anomalies indicative of malicious activities, and mapping adversary tactics to the MITRE ATT\&CK framework. You will collaborate with other CSOC team members and stakeholders to respond to and investigate security incidents, perform in\-depth forensic analysis to understand the nature and impact of threats, and provide detailed reports and briefings on threat hunting activities and findings to senior management.

**Recommended skills:**  

Threat Hunting \& Detection
  
* Conduct proactive threat hunting activities to detect advanced threats that evade traditional security solutions

Threat Intelligence \& Analysis

* Analyze advanced persistent threats (APTs) and understand adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs)

* Collaborate with other CSOC team members and stakeholders to respond to and investigate security incidents
* Perform in\-depth forensic analysis to understand the nature, scope, and impact of threats
* Conduct root cause analysis and impact assessments for security incidents
* Support containment, eradication, and recovery efforts during security incidents
* Coordinate response actions with SOC analysts, engineering teams, system owners, and government stakeholders
* Document incidents, response actions, and remediation recommendations in accordance with government reporting requirements


**Reporting \& Documentation:**  

* Provide detailed reports and briefings on threat hunting activities and findings to senior management
* Develop and maintain threat hunting playbooks, processes, and procedures

* Create and maintain technical documentation for detection rules, hunting queries, and analytical methodologies
* Clearly document findings, response actions, and technical recommendations


Continuous Improvement \& Compliance
  
* Participate in the development and refinement of security monitoring and incident response tools and processes
* Assist with security documentation, evidence collection, and audit response
* Validate security configurations against established baselines and policies
* Stay current with the latest cybersecurity trends, threat actor TTPs, and defensive technologies

As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **About The Role**


Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected. We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission\-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.


At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission you’ll define it. Lead the work that keeps America flying safely.

  

At Peraton, we don’t just manage projects—we deliver the systems that protect and advance U.S. air travel. We are seeking a **Technical Project Manager \- Senior** to lead complex, high\-visibility engineering and technology initiatives supporting the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This role sits at the heart of aviation modernization, where disciplined execution, technical excellence, and mission impact converge. If you thrive in environments where precision matters, collaboration is essential, and your work has national significance, this role offers both challenge and purpose.

  

**Work Location:**

**Program Execution**


* Own the full lifecycle of sophisticated network, infrastructure, and software projects—from concept through deployment.
* Translate complex engineering requirements into executable plans, schedules, and budgets using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.
* Align technical delivery with long\-term FAA modernization goals and program priorities.
* Support requirements analysis, system testing, readiness reviews, and operational transitions.
* Champion continuous improvement, bringing structure, consistency, and efficiency to complex engineering efforts.
* Drive projects to successful completion while meeting FAA standards, cost targets, and delivery commitments.

**Technical Leadership \& Collaboration**


* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional teams spanning software, hardware, networking, RAN, and systems integration.
* Partner closely with vendors, engineers, and program leaders to ensure seamless execution across all technical domains.
* Provide clear, confident briefings and milestone updates to FAA and senior program stakeholders.

**Risk Management with Real Impact**


* Anticipate and resolve technical risks, dependencies, and integration challenges—especially within network and infrastructure deployments.
* Ensure issues are identified early and addressed decisively to protect mission outcomes.

**Trusted Stakeholder Partner**

Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000\+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross\-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com.

**Job Description Summary:**


The Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) Analyst will be responsible the accurate assessment and analysis of DIB suppliers in support of defense programs. This position entails a focused commitment to critically assess companies in the defense industrial base and manage the implementation of Supply Chain Risk Management NIST 800\-53 control family to mitigate risks in the supply chain. The candidate should have experience drafting documentation to support compliance and process. This position will leverage existing supply chain risk technologies and stringent organizational protocols to ensure that analysis and processes are timely and processes in a manner that complies with program supply chain risk management policy requirements.**Job Description:**

**Duties/Responsibilities**

* Lead vulnerability identification activities by conducting advanced analysis of systems, programs and architectures to determine crucial components, high\-risk areas, and potential impacts across defense program supply chains.
* Conduct independent assessments and validations of supplier security practices to ensure compliance with federal defense and organizational requirements; document findings and provide expert recommendations to leadership and customers.
* Compile, synthesize and present complex risk assessments to internal stakeholders, executive leadership, and external customers to support informed decision making.
* Monitor and document major changes affective supply chain risk, quality, resilience, and compliance, ensuring that risks are escalated and mitigated proactively.
* Evaluate enterprise and supplier\-level risks within Draper’s SCRM programs, identifying systemic issues and recommending improvements to strengthen program maturity.
* Drive enhancements to the existing SCRM framework by incorporating stakeholder feedback, industry best practices and emerging regulatory requirements; lead implementation of approved updates.
* Perform rigorous quality checks of supplier reviews, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and analytical integrity; investigate discrepancies and deliver corrective action guidance.
* Collaborate cross functionally with engineering, product development, operations and security teams to ensure SCRM processes, standards and operations align with enterprise policies and strategic goals.
* Analyst multi\-source data to identify trends in supplier quality, product defects, or recurring vulnerabilities, and develop mitigation strategies to prevent future occurrences.
* Maintain readiness to perform additional responsibilities in support of evolving organizational needs.

**Skills/Abilities**

* Deep familiarity with software supply chain risks and the broader defense industrial base
* Strong working knowledge of SCRM NIST 800\-53 control family to mitigate risks in the supply chain, with experience drafting documentation to support compliance and process.
* Expert understanding of DFARS, FAR, TAA, and supply chain relevant compliance topics: NDAA 889, 1260H, nearshore/offshore guidance, country of origin risks and critical supply chain considerations.
* Ability to operate as an independent, action\-oriented self\-starter, prioritizing and managing multiple workstreams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proven success working within cross functional teams, adapting to changing priorities and providing leadership within complex matrixed environments.
* Familiarity with Quality Standards ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100 with demonstrated ability to integrate quality principals into supply chain risk processes.
* Advances skills in process integration including building workflows, identifying gaps and developing improvements to increase efficiency and reduce risk.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of conveying technical information clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Excellent time management skills with the proven ability to meet deadlines.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Outstanding written and oral communication skills, including development of formal assessments, reports and presentations.

* Requires a bachelor of Science degree an Engineering discipline.

We work with the agencies, contractors, and mission\-driven organizations that keep the nation safe, delivering the physical infrastructure that makes classified work possible. We're growing fast, operating across multiple markets, and building a company that takes both the mission and the business seriously.

**About the Role**



You will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of Nooks' physical spaces — from early design coordination through construction and handoff to Operations. This role exists because building accredited classified environments at speed and at scale requires a single owner who can hold scope, schedule, and budget across every site, translate Nooks' product standards into buildable solutions, and keep architects, engineers, and general contractors moving toward handoff. You will report into Nooks' Construction function within Product as an individual contributor, working from a remote or hybrid base with travel of up to 50% to project sites. In this role, you are an individual contributor as part of the Nooks Construction Team, under the VP of Product. You will work on a remote or hybrid basis with travel to project sites up to 50% of the time.



This is a builder role. While you'll have clearly defined ownership areas, priorities shift quickly in a fast\-moving, build\-heavy environment, and the right person steps into whatever the project needs — making decisions with imperfect information, improving the process as they go, and treating every build as a chance to make the next one more repeatable.

**Design Coordination \& Documentation**

jobs.description:
This posting is for a new vacancy.


Google utilizes AI tools to assist in assessing candidates in our hiring processes.

  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:  

  

**In\-office locations: Ottawa, ON, Canada; Toronto, ON, Canada; Montreal, QC, Canada.**  

**Remote location(s): Ontario, CA.**### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in a technical field.

* Experience of program delivery in defence or national security space.
* Strong track record of navigating high\-ambiguity environments and delivering results in a fast\-paced, evolving landscape.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and AI/ML tools to analyze program health and optimize workflows.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Google Public Sector, you will lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish, centred on ensuring we meet our contractual obligations and build enduring trust with our clients. You will work with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your role is essential in bridging the gap between business needs and technical execution, ensuring that our products and infrastructure are built to scale, meet the highest standards of development excellence and ensure that we deliver on the promises made, and that our obligations are met.


At this level, you are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy and navigate significant ambiguity. You will not only manage programs but also shape the strategic direction of your area, influencing development roadmaps, maintaining compliance with our commitments and obligations and driving expanded impact across multiple teams. You will lead by example, mentoring junior TPMs and fostering a culture of technical excellence and operational efficiency.


Google Public Sector brings the magic of Google to the mission of government and education with solutions purpose\-built for enterprises. We focus on helping United States public sector institutions accelerate their digital transformations, and we continue to make significant investments and grow our team to meet the complex needs of local, state and federal government and educational institutions.

  

Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

Canada: $166000 \- $170000 (CAD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Apply development\-level judgment to review architectures, shape technical specifications, and challenge assumptions to ensure robust scalability.
* Manage milestones, dependencies, and risks across cross\-functional teams, translating high\-level business objectives into actionable, multi\-quarter execution roadmaps.
* Ensure strict adherence to contractual client commitments across all relevant Master Services Agreements (MSAs), Statement of Works (SoWs), and order forms, actively identifying and closing delivery gaps.
* Implement modern AI/ML tooling to automate repetitive workflows, enhance data\-driven decision\-making, and boost team productivity.
* Build consensus across development, product, finance, and legal while refining standard program management methodologies to maximize overall velocity and transparency.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. jobs.description:
**About Cognizant Consulting:**  

Cognizant Consulting is more than Cognizant’s consulting practice—we’re a global community of 6,000\+ experts dedicated to helping clients reimagine their business. Blending our deep industry and technology advisory capability, we create innovative business solutions for Fortune 500 clients. And now, we’re looking for our next colleague who’ll join us in shaping the future of business. Could it be you?
  
  

**About the role:**  

As a Consulting Manager, Healthcare Business Transformation, you will make an impact by leading a comprehensive assessment of enterprise Long\-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) operations, identifying opportunities to improve process efficiency, system interoperability, data integrity, and financial performance. You will be a valued member of the Healthcare Consulting team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, LTSS operations teams, product owners, IT teams, architects, data analysts, finance leaders, and executive sponsors.
  
  

**In this role, you will:**  

* Lead end\-to\-end assessment and documentation of LTSS business processes across authorization, claims, provider, member, and financial workflows.
* Analyze interactions between Pega, QNXT, and related healthcare platforms to identify process, integration, and data flow gaps.
* Evaluate authorization\-to\-claims transaction integrity, data mappings, and operational controls to identify root causes of processing issues and financial leakage.
* Facilitate stakeholder workshops, discovery sessions, and executive presentations to align business and technology teams on findings and recommendations.
* Develop actionable remediation roadmaps, business cases, risk assessments, and transformation strategies that improve operational performance and reduce business risk.


**Work model:**  

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  

**What you need to have to be considered:**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in healthcare consulting, business transformation, program management, or healthcare operations.
* Strong experience with QNXT and healthcare payer platforms, including claims, benefits, enrollments, and authorization workflows.
* Experience working with Pega\-based healthcare workflows, care management, or authorization management processes.
* Proven expertise in healthcare process analysis, stakeholder management, business requirements, and current\-state/future\-state process mapping.
* Experience conducting system integration reviews, data lineage assessments, reconciliation analysis, and business impact evaluations.
* Strong communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
* Experience creating executive\-level deliverables, recommendations, remediation roadmaps, and transformation strategies.


**These will help you stand out:**  

* Experience supporting Molina Healthcare or other Medicaid and LTSS\-focused healthcare organizations.
* Knowledge of healthcare claims processing, financial workflows, payment integrity, and leakage analysis.
* Experience leading enterprise assessments involving interoperability, data governance, and technology modernization initiatives.
* Familiarity with healthcare regulatory requirements, managed care operations, and value\-based care environments.
* Experience with business architecture, process mining, workflow optimization, or healthcare transformation consulting engagements.


We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.
  
  

**Total Compensation:**  

The annual salary for this position is between $81,450 \- $129,500 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.
  
  

**Benefits:**  

Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:
  
* Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
* Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off.
* 401(k) plan and contributions.
* Long\-term/Short\-term Disability.
* Paid Parental Leave.
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan

jobs.title: Intelligence Manager, Global Intelligence Operations Center
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

 **Intelligence Manager, Global Intelligence Operations Center**

  

Dedicated Enterprise Account · Santa Monica, California

 **Location**

  

On\-site — Santa Monica, California

 **Employment type**

  

Full\-time, exempt. Dedicated to one client account.

 **Salary range**

  

$120,000 – $145,000 annually

 **Entity**

  

M1 Global — part of the Specialized family of brands

 **About M1 Global**

  

Since 1994, M1 Global has grown from a local security provider to the trusted security partner of Fortune 500 companies worldwide. We build security programs for complex enterprise environments — from loading docks to data centers, headquarters to event venues — powered by Aurix™, our proprietary automation platform that pairs skilled specialists with proven processes for industry\-leading prevention, detection and reporting. Wherever and however our clients operate, we integrate.

 **Protecting the companies that power the world.**

 **The Role**

  

You own the analytical standard. Every product the Global Intelligence Operations Center publishes to the client carries it — how sources are graded, how fact is separated from assessment, how confidence is stated, and what gets held back. You write that standard, you enforce it through a release gate, and you are answerable for the quality of every product the center publishes, on every shift.

  

The center runs 24/7/365 with watch officers supervising analysts on the floor at a one\-to\-two ratio. You lead those supervisors. You also produce the strategic assessments the watch floor cannot write — the quarterly view of the risk environment across the client's footprint, produced away from the alert queue so it is not written in the gaps between alerts.

  

You are engaged within thirty minutes on any declared incident, at any hour.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **Analytical Standards**

* Author and maintain the source validation policy, the confidence lexicon and the analytical writing standard, and publish them so an analyst and a client decision\-maker read the same words the same way.
* Operate the release gate. Decide what is published, what returns for rework and what is held, and be able to defend each call.
* Hold the line on tradecraft under time pressure. A fast product that overstates confidence is a failure.
 **Product Quality and Measurement**

* Own product quality measures including analytical writing quality, source validation compliance, assessment timeliness and release gate first\-pass rate.
* Ensure every product associated with a priority\-one event is reviewed, not sampled.
* Investigate misses to root cause and separate volume, staffing and platform tuning causes.
 **Strategic Production**

* Produce recurring strategic assessments of the risk environment affecting the client's global footprint, written for executive decision\-makers.
* Set the product mix with the client and retire products that no longer earn their place.
* Answer executive requests for information with sourced, defensible assessments inside agreed turnaround times.
 **Analyst Development**

* Lead and develop watch officers, intelligence analysts and the protective intelligence and travel security function.
* Coach on structured analytic technique, bias mitigation, source evaluation and analytical writing — continuously and in writing, not at annual review.
* Participate in quarterly blind calibration against the published rubric and reconcile scoring differences openly.
 **Incident and Crisis Support**

* Assume intelligence coordination authority on a declared incident and produce rolling situation reports at the cadence the client sets.
* Serve as the analytical voice to leadership during a crisis — give decision\-makers the picture they need in the time they have to decide.
* Direct surge analytical capacity when the situation requires it.
* Own the intelligence side of the handoff into physical security operations — what is passed, how fast it is acknowledged and whether it arrives usable. Handoff volume, acknowledgement time and handoff quality are measured and reported monthly.
 **Platform and Tradecraft**

* Own analytical use of the intelligence tool stack, including protective intelligence case management, alerting and mass notification platforms, and open\-source collection tooling.
* Drive alert relevance tuning and false\-positive triage, and evidence platform performance for the client, who holds the vendor relationships.
* Maintain the case record so an assessment does not reset when an analyst leaves.
 **Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Eight or more years in intelligence analysis, including three years leading or formally reviewing the work of other analysts.
* **Standard setting:** You have written and published an analytical writing standard, rubric or source grading policy that others were held to. Be prepared to discuss it.
* **Tradecraft:** Working command of structured analytic techniques, cognitive bias mitigation, source evaluation and grading, and open\-source intelligence tradecraft including digital hygiene.
* **Writing:** Proven analytical writing under time pressure, bottom line up front, with confidence and information gaps stated explicitly. A written product sample is required at interview.
* **Domain:** Demonstrable corporate protective intelligence, threat assessment or executive\-facing risk analysis experience. Console or dispatch experience is not a substitute.
* **Platforms:** Proficiency with commercial protective intelligence case management, real\-time alerting and mass notification platforms.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in international relations, security studies, political science, intelligence studies, journalism, criminal justice or a related analytical discipline — or equivalent military or government intelligence experience.
* **Eligibility:** Authorized to work in the United States. Able to pass background, drug and client\-required security screenin

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

  

  

Natixis Corporate \& Investment Banking is a leading global financial institution that provides advisory, investment banking, financing, corporate banking and capital markets services to corporations, financial institutions, financial sponsors and sovereign and supranational organizations worldwide.


Our teams of experts in close to 30 countries advise clients on their strategic development, helping them to grow and transform their businesses, and maximize their positive impact. Natixis CIB is committed to aligning its financing portfolio with a carbon neutrality path by 2050 while helping its clients reduce the environmental impact of their business.


As part of Groupe BPCE, the second largest banking group in France through the Banque Populaire and Caisse d’Epargne retail networks, Natixis CIB benefits from the Group’s financial strength and solid financial ratings (Standard \& Poor's: A\+, Moody's: A2, Fitch Ratings: A\+,R\&I: A\+).

  

  

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

  

Within IT GMR \- Booking Post Trade, you join the BPT\-GSF Equity team as a business analyst on the GMO part. The BPT GSF Equity team covers the steering, management and evolution of the Sophis Equity information system throughout the "Front to Risk to Back to Finance" chain, enabling the development in Europe and internationally of equity derivatives activities.


As part of the expansion of our Back\-Office projects, the mission will be to carry out the following tasks:
  

  

* Drafting the expressions of needs, designing the solution with the rest of the team, and drafting detailed specifications for the project manager,

  

* Make the necessary settings for implementing changes, develop the recipe plan for changes, and define the associated test sets in relation to users.

  

* Carry out the unit recipes and integration recipes for the relevant functions and interfaces, provide user training before start\-up, and participate in production monitoring on SOPHIS for the Derivatives sector.

  

* Sophis software package: Confirmed level
* Equity derivatives: Confirmed level
* Accounting: Master level
* MOA project lifecycle experience: Confirmed level
* Financial products on Equity derivatives: Confirmed level

You may also be required to manage small projects.


**\#TransformatveFinance**The position is based in Paris and with us it’s 10 days of remote work per month, 15 to 17 days of RTT per year, on\-site services such as catering, gym or corporate concierge. Our compensation consists of a fixed amount, an annual bonus, and a corporate savings plan including profit\-sharing, participation, and matching funds.


We place our employees at the center of our attention. Internal mobility, career development and training programs allow you to grow and flourish throughout your journey.


You work in a hybrid, inclusive and collaborative working environment.


You also have the opportunity to engage in favor of society and causes that are important to you through our corporate foundation.

You will be contacted by one of our recruiters before meeting our business experts (manager, team member or business sector).

  

  

**Required Skills/Qualifications/Experience**
---------------------------------------------

  

  

About you: If you recognize yourself in the following description, you are made to work with us!
  

With a higher education, you have at least 6 years of experience in business analyst positions, notably on a Sophis environment.
  

  

You master:
  

* Equity derivatives;
* The Sophis software
* The front to back chain (booking, life cycle);
* Back Office features: payment, accounting, confirmation;
* Organization and work in agile mode;
* All the steps of carrying out a development until its production (framing of the expression of need, specification, IT tests and users).

  

You are:
  

* Autonomous and proactive;
* Endowed with a sense of collectivity and able to work as part of a team;
* Customer service oriented and always attentive to users.

  

You master English with a B2 level.
  

Tell us you are interested in replying to this ad.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (H/F) Marketing Santé - alternance
jobs.description:
Fondé en 1969, Cegedim est un Groupe innovant de technologies et de services spécialisé dans la gestion des flux numériques de l’écosystème santé et BtoB, ainsi que dans la conception de logiciels métier destinés aux professionnels de santé et de l’assurance. Cegedim compte près de 6 500 collaborateurs dans plus de 10 pays et a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 649,2 millions d’euros en 2025\.


Pour en savoir plus : www.cegedim.fr


Et suivez Cegedim sur Twitter : @CegedimGroup, LinkedIn et Facebook.

**Contexte :**


L'activité Flux Santé de Cegedim, éditeur de logiciels de référence dans le secteur de la santé, accompagne depuis plus de 30 ans l’ensemble de l’écosystème de santé – établissements, industriels, et professionnels de santé – dans leur transformation digitale.


Au cœur de cette mission, Cegedim opère et sécurise des flux d'informations critiques, grâce à une expertise unique en interopérabilité, gestion des données de santé et en processus métiers.


Au sein de notre équipe Marketing Santé, vous jouerez un rôle clé en amont de l'action commerciale : éclairer les décisions par la donnée.

 **Mission générale**

  



Vous êtes **ingénieur avec une appétence pour le commerce** et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement où la donnée sert directement la stratégie commerciale. Votre rôle : transformer les données clients en **insights actionnables**, fournir aux commerciaux des **dossiers de rendez\-vous à forte valeur ajoutée**, et contribuer à la **communication opérationnelle** via des contenus simples orientés business.

**Responsabilités principales**

  



* **Analyse avancée des données clients**— extraction, nettoyage, structuration et modélisation des données issues du CRM, bases de données internes, et données externes
* **Préparation de l'action commerciale** — synthèse des comportements clients, scoring, historique, opportunités, KPIs clés, fiches d'aide à la vente transmises aux équipes commerciales
* **Restitution et dataviz** — conception de tableaux de bord et de reportings (Power BI, Excel…) pour suivre les indicateurs marketing et partager les insights avec les équipes.
* **Veille analytique**— benchmark des pratiques data, exploration de nouveaux indicateurs, outils ou méthodes.
* **Mise en forme de supports commerciaux**: présentations, fiches produits, cas clients.
* **Production de contenus simples** pour les réseaux sociaux : posts, visuels, mini\-vidéos orientées business.

  

Étudiant(e) en école d’ingénieur (Bac\+3 à Bac\+5\) avec spécialisation data, informatique, mathématiques appliquées ou systèmes d’information, vous recherchez une alternance d'un à deux ans.

  


* **Compétences data** : maîtrise d'Excel, premières expériences en SQL et sur un outil de dataviz (Power BI, Tableau…) ; des notions de Python ou R sont un plus.
* **Esprit d'analyse** : vous aimez faire parler les chiffres et transformer la donnée brute en recommandations actionnables
* **Sens business** : curieux(se) des enjeux commerciaux et marketing, vous comprenez les enjeux liés à la donnée, et que votre analyse sert la performance des équipes de vente.
* **Qualités relationnelles** : rigueur, autonomie et capacité à vulgariser vos résultats auprès d'interlocuteurs non techniques. Aisance relationnelle avec les équipes commerciales comme les équipes techniques des opérations et de la R\&D


Un intérêt pour le secteur de la santé et ses enjeux (réglementation, e\-santé, données de santé) sera particulièrement apprécié.


 Nous rejoindre en alternance, c'est aussi rejoindre notre Communauté Alternants !


Chez nous, 3 événements par an sont organisés pour se former, créer des liens forts entre alternants.


Et ce n'est que le début : d'autres projets sont à venir.


Venez apprendre, partager et grandir avec nous !


Découvrez les témoignages de nos étudiants :


Nos alternants ont la parole \- Rayane, Consultant Technique


Nos alternants ont la parole \- Sandra, Chargée de Communication

**? maîtrise des fondamentaux de la Data Engineering :** tables de faits et dimensions, cardinalité, architecture médaillon
  
**? maîtrise de la suite Power BI :** data visualisation, DAX, modèles de données, administration de Power BI Services
  
? maîtrise avancée d?Excel

? connaissance de Dataiku appréciée
  
  

**Compétences relationnelles et qualités personnelles :**  

? capacité d?écoute

? capacité d?analyse

jobs.title: Project Manager - Design and Construction
jobs.description:
**ABOUT NOOKS**



Nooks is pioneering Classified\-Infrastructure\-as\-a\-Service (CIaaS) — designing, building, and operating Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and other secured, classified environments for the defense and national security community. We work with the agencies, contractors, and mission\-driven organizations that keep the nation safe, delivering the physical infrastructure that makes classified work possible. We're growing fast, operating across multiple markets, and building a company that takes both the mission and the business seriously.

**About the Role**



You will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of Nooks' physical spaces — from early design coordination through construction and handoff to Operations. This role exists because building accredited classified environments at speed and at scale requires a single owner who can hold scope, schedule, and budget across every site, translate Nooks' product standards into buildable solutions, and keep architects, engineers, and general contractors moving toward handoff. You will report into Nooks' Construction function within Product as an individual contributor, working from a remote or hybrid base with travel of up to 50% to project sites. In this role, you are an individual contributor as part of the Nooks Construction Team, under the VP of Product. You will work on a remote or hybrid basis with travel to project sites up to 50% of the time.



This is a builder role. While you'll have clearly defined ownership areas, priorities shift quickly in a fast\-moving, build\-heavy environment, and the right person steps into whatever the project needs — making decisions with imperfect information, improving the process as they go, and treating every build as a chance to make the next one more repeatable.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Design Coordination \& Documentation**


* Coordinate the full drawing process across schematic design, design development, and construction document (SD, DD, CD) phases, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment to Nooks standards
* Partner with Product Security to translate program and accreditation requirements into buildable, repeatable solutions
* Review drawing sets with architects and engineers to resolve constructability issues before they reach the field


**Construction Execution**


* Oversee general contractors and vendors through construction, owning schedule tracking, site coordination, and issue resolution
* Review requests for information (RFIs), submittals, and change orders against design intent and budget before approval
* Lead permitting and approvals, managing submissions and comment responses to protect the schedule


**Project Controls \& Delivery**


* Own each project from early design through turnover, holding scope, schedule, and budget at every stage
* Track milestones and surface risks early, driving mitigation before they affect delivery
* Partner with Finance to monitor budgets, validate changes, and maintain financial control across the project lifecycle


**Quality \& Closeout**


* Enforce build quality and consistency as Nooks scales across sites, reinforcing repeatable standards
* Run internal and external project meetings that keep decisions, accountability, and momentum on track
* Drive closeout — punch lists, final inspections, and handoff to Operations


**What Success Looks Like in This Role**



Within the first year, this person has taken multiple Nooks sites from design through turnover on schedule and on budget, with no surprises that leadership learns about late. Drawing sets move cleanly through SD, DD, and CD because issues are caught and resolved before they reach the field. Contractors and vendors are managed tightly, with RFIs, submittals, and change orders reviewed against both design intent and budget. Construction leadership relies on this person as the single owner of delivery for their projects — knowing the status, the risks, and the path to handoff at any moment. As the playbook matures, each build is more repeatable than the last.


**Cross\-Functional Expectations**



You will work daily with Product on standards and program requirements, with Finance on budget control and change validation, and with IT/Cyber and Operations to ensure each space is built to accreditation and ready for handoff. Externally, you are Nooks' primary point of contact for architects, engineers, consultants, and general contractors — driving their work to Nooks standards rather than simply receiving it. Success in these relationships means deciding quickly with imperfect information and keeping every party aligned on scope, schedule, and budget.


**The Skillset**


**Hard requirements**


* 7–10 years of project management in construction and architecture, with direct ownership of drawings and construction execution
* Demonstrated experience coordinating drawing sets across SD, DD, and CD phases and reviewing for constructability
* Experience managing contractors and vendors, including RFIs, submittals, and change orders, to spec
* Working knowledge of permitting and approvals processes and how to navigate them efficiently
* Ability to communicate with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and keep teams aligned
* Proficiency with project management platforms (e.g., Procore), Google Workspace, and industry\-standard drawing\-review software


**Preferred**


* Experience in a high\-growth or startup environment, particularly multi\-site or repeatable build programs
* Proximity to a major airport


**Eligibility \& Clearance**



Candidates must be a United States Citizen. An active security clearance is preferred. All candidates must be eligible for and committed to obtaining and maintaining eligibility up to the Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) level as a condition of employment.

jobs.description:
Risk Intelligence Analyst – Overnight Shift **This position is fully on\-site \-****Overnight Shift:** 6:00PM \- 6:00AM

* **Week 1: Sunday \- Wednesday**
* **Week 2: Sunday \- Tuesday**


Prosegur’s Global Risk Services (GRS) operates Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) services for our clients as a dedicated, managed service. This position is part of a dedicated, embedded team supporting an multinational client in the medical technology sector. This high\-performing team of Risk Intelligence Analysts is responsible for monitoring threats to travelers, intaking and assessing intelligence alerts, providing support for the crisis management program, and conducting protective intelligence monitoring to assist the Executive Protection (EP) team on a 24x7x365 basis. This intelligence\-focused GSOC works closely with the client’s Global Security staff to provide custom intelligence products to support the client’s needs.


The **Risk Intelligence Analyst** is a specialized, leadership role within the GSOC. This analyst provides focused intelligence and threat monitoring in direct support of EP teams. While sharing the core duties of the Risk Intelligence Analyst, this role emphasizes proactive identification, analysis, and communication of threats impacting executives, their families, and company operations. Responsibilities include drafting executive\-level security overviews for international travel and events, monitoring and reporting on executive travel, conducting deep social media monitoring to identify and escalate threats, engaging with third\-party security providers to provide intelligence support during EP operations, as well as conducting research and leveraging behavioral threat analysis techniques to assess risks posed by identified Persons of Interest (POIs).

**Responsibilities**


The main responsibilities of the EP Intelligence Analyst include:

* Monitor global events and provide real\-time intelligence and overwatch of client operations, with **priority focus on executive protection assignments, executive travel, residences, and corporate facilities**.
* Fuse internal and external intelligence sources to research, analyze, and aggregate threat data specifically related to executive movements, public appearances, and exposure.
* Conduct protective intelligence assessments to identify individuals, groups, or movements posing potential threats to executives leveraging both research skills and behavioral threat analysis techniques
* Deliver timely alerts and specialized threat advisories tailored to executive protection teams.
* Support advance planning for executive travel and events by providing country, regional, and event\-specific risk intelligence.
* Provide **direct intelligence support to executive protection agents and coordinate with both in\-house and third\-party EP teams**, ensuring they have actionable threat assessments before and real\-time situational awareness during missions.
* Utilize social media monitoring, OSINT, and specialized protective intelligence tools to track potential hostile surveillance, protests, threats, or other emerging risks to executives and company operations.
* Monitor, report on, and provide situational awareness on senior executive travewl including compiling upcoming travel reports, daily executive travel briefings, etc.
* Conduct ad\-hoc briefings for senior leadership and EP agents on unfolding events impacting executives.
* Develop specialized protective intelligence products, such as **Executive Threat Profiles, Event Risk Assessments, and Protective Travel Advisories**.
* Coordinate with GSOC peers to ensure alignment on global incident response, escalation, and dispatch of protective services. Provide front\-line, dotted\-line leadership over the GSOC by providing training and infusing protective intelligence capabilities across the wider team.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and back\-up to the GSOC Program Manager, as needed.
* Liaise directly with company EP leadership and internal stakeholders, including Corporate Aviation, HR, Legal, and other stakeholders.
* Support weekly and quarterly reporting with sections dedicated to executive protection threat trends.
* Maintain, update, and monitor a comprehensive POI database via the client’s internal case management system (Ontic); ensure appropriate investigative capabilities are being leveraged effectively and active alerting thresholds are in place.
* Provide core analytical support to wider GSOC\-managed programs including travel security monitoring, intelligence assessment and alerting, assisting with investigations, and providing support to the crisis management program.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Prior experience in a GSOC, security operations, intelligence analysis, or risk monitoring role.
* Familiarity with global security threats, including crime, protests, geopolitical instability, natural disasters, and targeted violence.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Teams, Excel, SharePoint).
* Excellent communication and customer service skills.

  

At Prosegur, we make our world safer by taking care of people and businesses while remaining at the forefront of innovation. Every day, we work to secure what our clients value most, from their families to their assets, from their reputation to their networks, and from their money to their cloud. As the 3rd largest security services provider, our 175k\+ team members in 36 countries combine and adapt global best practices to match the unique nature of each market we serve and partner with Electronic Security, Global Risk Services, CyberSecurity, and Remote Services (iSOC) divisions to create meaningful ‘Hybrid Security' solutions for Prospects.

The M\&A IT Business Analyst supports the planning and execution of IT activities for mergers and acquisitions at Adobe. This role partners with cross\-functional teams—including GTM, Sales, Product, Finance, Corporate Development, and IT—to gather requirements, analyze business processes, track integration activities, and support successful transaction outcomes.
  
The Business Analyst translates business needs into clear requirements, plans, and insights throughout the M\&A lifecycle. The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, collaborative, and comfortable working with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  
  

**What you'll Do:**  

Support IT workstreams across the M\&A lifecycle, including due diligence, pre\-close planning, Day 1 readiness, and post\-close integration.
  
  

Gather, document, and validate business and technical requirements with functional stakeholders and system owners.

Translate business requirements into process flows, user stories, functional requirements, and actionable work plans.
  
  

Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to track milestones, deliverables, decisions, risks, issues, and dependencies.
  
  

Assist with systems assessments and rationalization activities across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, collaboration tools, identity management, and data environments.

Facilitate working sessions, document decisions and action items, and follow up with owners to support timely completion.
  
  

Maintain and improve M\&A IT playbooks, templates, process flows, checklists, and other integration tools.
  
  

Identify process improvement opportunities and help develop repeatable practices for future transactions.

What you need to succeed
  
  

Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, information systems, finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  

At least 3 years of experience in business analysis, technology consulting, project coordination, IT operations, or a related role.

jobs.description:
**Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front\-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.**


Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award\-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.


But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online \- and we’re proud to be recognized as a **BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year**, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people\-first workplace.


Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

jobs.title: AV Field Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

The Field Implementation Manager (FIM) is a senior field leadership and technical execution
  
governance role within Diversified’s Technical Operations (Tech Ops) organization. This position
  
serves as the highest field\-facing execution authority during the implementation phase of projects
  
and is accountable for ensuring that complex broadcast, media, experiential AV, and enterprise AV
  
systems are executed safely, accurately, efficiently, and in full alignment with engineering intent,
  
project schedules, and Diversified standards.
  
  

The FIM plays a critical role before installation begins by partnering with the Account Executive during
  
early site walks and pre\-implementation assessments to evaluate site conditions, access,
  
infrastructure readiness, constructability, sequencing constraints, and unique environmental
  
considerations. The FIM is responsible for documenting and clearly communicating these findings
  
through written assessments, photographs, diagrams, and annotated drawings as required, ensuring
  
Engineering, Project Management, Fabrication, and Operations teams have a shared and accurate
  
understanding of the installation environment.
  
  

During execution, the FIM operates above Installation Site Supervisors and Lead Technicians,
  
providing multi\-site execution governance, technical escalation authority, and field leadership across
  
active projects. The FIM ensures that systems are not only installed correctly, but that what was
  
designed, fabricated, kitted, shipped, and delivered matches specification exactly, with zero\-defect
  
expectations applied to materials readiness, logistics coordination, and commissioning
  
preparedness.
  
  

The Field Implementation Manager works in close collaboration with Tech Ops Project Managers,
  
Engineering (COE), Fabrication Services, Operations, Logistics \& Compliance, and Supply Chain to
  
ensure a seamless transition from design through fabrication, kitting, delivery, installation, and
  
commissioning. As a highly visible, customer\-facing leader, the FIM must demonstrate
  
professionalism, composure, and technical clarity, including the ability to answer challenging
  
technical questions or translate complex systems into clear, client\-understandable terms with
  
patience and confidence.
  
  

The Field Implementation Manager operates as the technical execution authority within the Tech Ops
  
delivery framework, ensuring that engineering design intent is translated into disciplined,
  
predictable, and high\-quality field implementation. In doing so, the role protects system integrity,
  
reinforces installation discipline across multiple projects, and ensures that the transition from
  
design and fabrication to field implementation occurs with precision and consistency.
  
Success in this role directly impacts execution quality, schedule reliability, client confidence, and
  
Diversified’s reputation for delivering complex systems with discipline, precision, and excellence.
  
  

**The Field Implementation Manager exists to ensure that:**  

* Engineering intent is executed without compromise
* Site conditions and constraints are accurately understood and communicated early
* Fabricated systems are built, kitted, delivered, and installed exactly as specified
* Field execution operates with consistency, safety, and predictability
* Client confidence is reinforced through informed, calm, and professional leadership


**What You’ll Do:**  

Pre\-Implementation Site Assessment \& Project Readiness
  
* Conduct initial site walks with the Account Executive to assess scope, scale, access, infrastructure readiness, and environmental constraints
* Identify site\-specific risks impacting installation sequencing, logistics, safety, or cost
* Document site conditions using written assessments, photographs, sketches, and diagrams as required
* Communicate site findings clearly to Engineering, Project Management, Fabrication Services, and Operations teams
* Support site surveys for project planning and sales support e•orts


Field Execution Governance \& Quality Oversight
  
* Provide senior oversight across active job sites within the assigned region
* Serve as the first point of escalation for field execution, quality, safety, or technical issues
* Inspect and verify installation quality, workmanship standards, and adherence to engineering designs
* Confirm installed systems match approved designs, specifications, and kitting documentation
* Verify commissioning readiness prior to system turn\-up


Fabrication, Kitting \& Logistics Coordination
  
* Maintain close collaboration with Fabrication Services and fabrication technicians to ensure systems are built exactly as designed
* Ensure racks and systems are kitted in a zero\-defect manner, including hardware, cabling, labeling, documentation, and accessories
* Coordinate with Operations, Logistics \& Compliance and Supply Chain for timely, safe, and accurate delivery of kitted systems to job sites
* Verify material completeness and readiness prior to site installation activities
* Escalate fabrication or logistics discrepancies immediately to prevent downstream execution risk
