jobs.title: Associate Deployment Strategist (AI/ML Product)
jobs.description:
**About Pallet**

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We've raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we've achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.



Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end\-to\-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.



As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting\-edge AI capabilities, we're positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.



Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

**$100,000 \- $150,000**  

*Full\-time / Onsite (5 days/week) / \~25\-30% Travel*


**About the Role**



As Pallet scales with mid\-market and enterprise customers, deployments need to be clear, organized, and deeply customer\-aware. Customers are adopting AI agents in real operational workflows, which means the details matter: requirements, edge cases, stakeholder alignment, change management, testing, and go\-live support.



The Associate Deployment Strategist helps own customer deployments from discovery and workflow design through execution, launch, and ongoing success. You'll work closely with customers, Agent Delivery Engineers, Product, Sales, and Success to turn messy real\-world processes into reliable AI agent workflows.



This is a client\-facing, high\-growth role for someone early in their career who is highly organized, analytical, and comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment. You'll primarily support mid\-market deployments, own day\-to\-day customer coordination, and partner with senior team members on larger or more complex accounts.


**Why This Role Is Different**



You won't inherit a fully built playbook; you'll help create it. This role sits at the center of customer deployment, product feedback, and operational execution. You'll work directly with customers, learn how AI agents are deployed in mission\-critical workflows, and help shape how Pallet scales implementation across a growing customer base.


**How You'll Make an Impact**


* Serve as the executive point of contact for customer deployments and long\-term success
* Lead customer discovery to understand workflows, constraints, and success criteria
* Translate complex business processes into executable AI agent workflows
* Partner with Agent Delivery Engineers to validate assumptions and execute technically
* Configure, test, and release agent configurations for customer use cases
* Own deployment plans, timelines, risks, and stakeholder communication
* Lead customer kickoffs, milestone reviews, QBRs, and executive updates
* Proactively manage scope changes, escalations, and expectation\-setting
* Improve and scale onboarding and deployment processes over time
* Travel for key customer milestones and kickoffs as needed (\~25%)


**What Success Looks Like**


* Customers have clearly defined, executable workflows aligned to their business reality
* Deployments stay on track despite ambiguity, changing requirements, or complexity
* Executives feel informed, confident, and trust Pallet as a long\-term partner
* Internal teams are aligned, accountable, and coordinated around customer outcomes
* Deployment processes become more repeatable and scalable without sacrificing quality


**What You'll Bring**


* 1\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing, operations, implementation, consulting, product, support, or technical project role
* Strong organization and follow\-through across multiple workstreams
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort working with customers and asking thoughtful questions
* Ability to break down complex workflows into clear steps, requirements, and decisions
* Interest in AI, automation, logistics, and operational systems
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
* Comfort working in spreadsheets and presentation tools
* Basic technical acumen, including familiarity with APIs, JSON, SQL, or system workflows
* Ability to operate in a fast\-moving environment and create structure from ambiguity


**Nice to Have**


* Experience at a SaaS, logistics, supply chain, marketplace, or workflow automation company
* Experience working with AI\-driven or automation products
* Technical degree or technical coursework in CS, Engineering, Math, Data, or related fields
* Prior experience in implementation, customer success, solutions, or operations


**Location \& Logistics**


* In\-person, based in our San Francisco office or NYC office
* Travel required for major customer milestones
* Interviewing: Remote with final in\-person round


**Interview Process**



* Chat with Recruiter (30 min)


* Chat with Member of the Team (45 min)


* Chat with Member of the Team (45 min)


* Chat with Hiring Manager (45 mins)


* Final Interview Loop (3 hours)


* Background \& reference checks



We move fast and keep candidates informed at every stage.


**Compensation**



The estimated salary range for this role is $100,000 – $150,000, depending on experience and skill set. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and growth opportunities. Final compensation will be determined based on a combination of factors, including experience, qualifications, and location.

**Our Benefits**



We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

jobs.description:

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company.

Experience working with and analyzing data.  
* 

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience gathering and analyzing data to uncover insights.
* Experience managing complex systems, cross\-functional stakeholder groups, and large\-scale change management initiatives.
* Strong problem solving skills, combined with outstanding business judgment, communication, and prioritization skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  

  

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.



The Education team's mission is to transform learning and teaching at scale. We do this by helping K\-12 and higher education institutions around the world bring the best of Google tools and technology to their organizations. We've made significant headway on this journey. With AI, the potential for technology to enhance education is greater than ever.


The Strategy and Operations team will help shape the cross\-Google narrative for Google Education, translating our high\-level outlook into an operational reality, ensuring our business is run effectively. In this role, you will have the defining opportunity to transform teaching and learning for students globally. By harnessing learning science and the breakthrough capabilities being developed across Google, you will shape the future of education.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $126000 \- $180000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Establish Key Performance Indicators and timelines for each project, regular metrics reporting, that tie back to strategic goals, and post\-implementation impact analysis.
* Drive end\-to\-end operational aptitude to ensure flawless execution of the highest\-priority goals.
* Support annual planning activities for the Edu portfolio.
* Contribute on strategic projects that are operationally intensive and cross\-functional to ensure there is structure and timely delivery of project goals.

The YouTube Business Central Strategy and Operations Team is responsible for leading global, cross\-functional initiatives to drive the unprecedented growth and health of the YouTube creator and partner ecosystem. The core capabilities of the team include planning and business operations, incentives design and operations, and business strategy and operations for the three regions: Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

new_jobs.description:
**About Centric Software:**

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI\-enabled product\-concept\-to\-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best\-of\-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever\-changing market.  



Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.  



**Job title:** Project Manager


**Location:** Anywhere in US / Remote


**Experience level:** 10 Years


**Compensation:** Negotiable  



  

**Job Description**  

The Project Manager is the primary client\-facing leader responsible for the successful end\-to\-end deployment of Centric PLM for assigned clients. This role ensures that all projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the defined scope, while strictly adhering to the Centric PMO’s standard implementation methodology and best practices.  

  



**Key Accountabilities \& Responsibilities**

**Project Planning \& Scoping:** Develop detailed project plans, timelines, resource allocation schedules, and communication strategies in accordance with the PMO standards.


**Forecast:** Provide and regularly update an accurate resource allocation forecasts. Monitor project hours, resources, and expenses against the budget. Provide a weekly budget report


**Client Management:** Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for the client project team, managing expectations, coordinating meetings, and facilitating all key project milestones (e.g., Blueprinting, configuration, testing. training, go\-live).


**Process Execution \& Compliance:** Rigorously execute the project using Centric implementation methodology, ensuring all required internal documentation and phase gate approvals are completed and auditable.


**Risk \& Change Management:** Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks and issues. Manage all scope change requests using the formal change control process, escalating potential budget or timeline threats to the Director as needed.


**Team Coordination:** Coordinate activities between the client’s team, the internal technical consultants, and subject matter experts (SMEs) to ensure smooth transitions between project phases.


**Knowledge \& skills requirements**

**Required Technical Mastery:** Demonstrated proficiency in managing complex, multi\-phase enterprise software implementation projects. Strong working knowledge of relevant project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, MS Project).


**Organizational Knowledge:** Practical understanding of Centric PLM integration with typical client business processes and IT environments.


**Specific Certification/Training:** A Formal training or certification in a recognized project management methodology (e.g., PMP, CAPM, or Scrum Master) is preferred


**Communication \& Governance:** Proven ability to run effective project steering committee meetings and clearly articulate complex technical and business issues to both client and internal stakeholders.


**Top Success Criteria**

**Client Satisfaction:** Ensure that the deployed solution is aligned with the customer’s expectations


**On\-Time Delivery:** Successfully complete all assigned projects within the defined timeline variance established by the PMO.


**Process Compliance:** Pass all internal project audits demonstrating adherence to PMO documentation, methodology and forecasting standards.


**Client Handoff:** Ensure a clean, successful transition to the Customer Support/ CS Team  



  

The US base salary range for this full\-time position is **Negotiable** . Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location. The range for each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed reflect the base salary and certain positions may be offered with additional variable incentives.  



*Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.*
